⟦Power Level: Heavenly Ascension⟧
⟦Description:
↠ It was said that everyone deserves a second chance. However, what if the person was one of the very few who came close to killing the Primordial Chaos Dragon (Guardian of the Universe)?

↠ This is the story of Hera, a sister and friend who let her pain of losing her sisters turn her bitter to the point she lost her way and became vengeful that the bodies left in her wake shook the high heavens.

↠ She was the sister of Artemis, the poor soul whose fate ended when she met the Chaos Dragon, ultimately leading to her tragic death. After she died, Hera became so angry that she made it a must to use any means necessary to kill Chaos.

↠ So she embarked on a journey, one filled with pain and bloodshed. She accumulated power to the point that the fate that was written for her changed into one she made for herself. Her vengeance twisted her fate, sending her downhill.
↠ The day she came face to face with the one she blamed for her sister’s death, she became unrecognisable. Her hatred had twisted and made her bitter.
↠ In the end, she died at the unwilling hand of the Chaos Dragon, something he regretted to the point of planting a heart demon in him, a heart demon he still struggles with to this day.

↠ Now you have the chance to save her and, in doing so, save the Chaos Dragon from the pain he is destined to go through. This mission is to bring two sisters together and, in doing so, save the one whose destiny and fate are tied to the Universe.⟧
⟦Kill as many as you want, for this planet is doomed⟧
⟦Rewards⟧
↠ 30 Billion Tower Points
↠ 300 Billion Soul Essence
↠ Limit Breaker Key (Everybody)
↠ Innate Talent Awakening Pill
↠ Destiny Memory Key (Hera)
By the time Unity was done reading the last sentence, tears started rolling down her face. Vexthra hugged her and planted her face into her chest, letting her tears soak her clothes.
The rest of her sisters joined in, making sure Unity is alright.

They are already aware of what happened to her during the Primordial Era. Although she had no idea she died, she told them she started following (stalking) Chaos after he saved them from the Forsaken Kings.
So they know she was once Artemis.
Now, it seems she died tragically, and her death seems to have caused more pain than she would have wanted. She was a genius in her family, more so than her sister.
However, her death had transformed the gentle soul she knew into a vengeful spirit, one that nearly cost the Chaos Dragon his life and, in turn, would have caused the destruction of the universe.

She became shattered when she learned what her death had done to her sister. The Hera she knew was a saint. She wouldn’t even hurt a fly, so hearing what she became broke her heart into several pieces.
"Veera, how long until you can wake them up?" Vexthra asked, already angry. When it comes to her man and her sisters, there is nothing else more important.
Of course, she would not admit it, but Unity is her favourite. She loves her more than the rest of her sisters, so seeing her broken made her become angry.
Veera waved her staff, and a dark mist spread across the corpses on the ground. A few seconds later, they started moving.

sentences.text: [Five hours later - Sixth floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon]
"Big sister, it has already been five hours.
I think we should head to the seventh floor," Unity said, her expression calm.
Just sitting there, doing absolutely nothing, is getting to her.
It had already been five hours since their search on the sixth floor.
They were supposed to climb to the seventh floor.
However, Vexthra decided to wait till she heard from Kent.
However, it had already been 5 hours, which is actually 5 days inside the tower.
But no word came from him or Miryssa.
This means he and Miryssa still hadn’t woken up from whatever happened when he cum in her.
She also didn’t want to go into the tower, since she didn’t want to disturb them.
Now, it seemed to her that perhaps they had waited long enough.
"I guess you are right.
Let’s go then."
Vexthra opened the portal to the 7th floor, and they all walked in.
They have 30 more floors to climb after the 7th, so the earlier they make progress, the better.
[3 Days Ago - Planet Gladiator]
"Let go of me, you bastards." A young lady wiggled her arm, attempting to free herself from the grip of three burly men, too large and strong to call them dark elves.
But they are, in fact, Dark Elves.
As for the lady, she is slender and a bit weak, a unique trait of an Elf.
However, she is in no way weaker than a Death Stage warrior.
That is because she has so much influence and threat to many in her world.
She lives in a world of constant battle and bloodshed.
From the day she was born – 1300 years ago – she had never known peace, not even for a moment.
If not running from one blade to another, then it is chasing after a threat to eliminate it.
Her life had always been about battle.
From what she knew, long before she was born, Planet Gladiator was a peaceful world, ruled by a benevolent Elven Queen.
However, when the Dark Elves arrived, everything turned upside down, plunging the peaceful world into chaos and constant battle.
The entire planet, with billions of people, was taken over.
However, just like in any dictatorship, there are rebels.
She was born into the family of rebels.
So from the start, she had already become an enemy of the Dark Elves.
She had helped many escape their tyranny and achieve some form of normalcy.
However, a couple of days ago, she was betrayed by one of her lieutenants, leading to an ambush.
She killed quite a lot of Dark Elves, but with no reinforcement coming, she was finally subdued.
"There is nowhere else to run, Rebel Dia.
Your days of defiance have come to an end." One of the Dark Elves said before knocking her unconscious.
The three Dark Elves took a deep breath.
Looking around, the bodies of dozens of dead Dark Elves could be seen.
It is clear they lost many men before finally subduing her.
"What a headache.
I am going to enjoy torturing her after Lord Pilio is done with her."
"Same here.
She has caused us to lose too many men." After making sure everything was in order, they left the scene and headed back to the city.
Three days later, a portal opened in the same place where the battle happened.
Vexthra and her team walked out, everyone raising their guard the next second.
"What happened here?" Mara asked, looking around.
The bodies of the Dark Elves still littered the place, perfectly preserved considering they still have some spiritual Qi in them.
"Looks like one person did all this," Vexthra analysed the scene and said.
The consistent cuts on either their throats or chests show that only one person using a blade did all that.
"Veera, start working on reviving them," Vexthra instructed before checking the mission they were currently on.
She shared it with them like always.

chapters.title: Chapter 1354: The Seventh Floor - GladiaDom (2)
paragraphs: Veera is a necromancer, so raising the dead is right up her alley. This also means they wouldn’t have to search aimlessly for the person they’re looking for.
As the mist spread, the bodies of the dead Dark Elves started to move.
This prompted her to start muttering some incantations. A few minutes later, 34 Dark Elves that were supposed to be dead stood before her, their expressions dark and twisted.
Veera closed her eyes for a few seconds, reading through their memories. Once she acquired what she wanted, she sent the undead Dark Elves away.𝚏𝕣𝕖𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚋𝚗𝐨𝐯𝕖𝕝.𝕔𝐨𝕞
"It seems this planet was taken over by the Dark Elves thousands of years ago. It used to be a world of the Elves, but now, they have been suppressed and reduced to slaves.
However, there is a rebel force, one that has been fighting against the Dark Elves for years now. They have many top warriors among them.
However, of all the rebel warriors, one of them stood out. Her name is Dia, a sword maiden who has killed thousands of Dark Elves and saved many Elves.
Three days ago, a close friend of hers betrayed her, leading to an ambush. As you all can see, she fought hard, but in the end, she was captured.

From the memories I have retrieved from the undead Dark Elves, whenever a rebel soldier is captured, the Dark Elves will perform public execution in the most painful way possible as a way of sending a message to the rebel force."
Vexthra gritted her teeth, turning to Kaizo... "Take a team and go to wherever they took her and make sure she is rescued. I don’t care how many you have to kill, just rescue her."
"As you command, goddess." Since the cultivation requirement for this mission is just Heavenly Ascension, not even Uncle Drew can join in the fun. So it all falls down to Kaizo.

Naturally, knowing this mission is important to Unity, all of them want to go. However, Kaizo, being the warrior at heart, knew this mission was also a training for them, so he only added nine to himself, making a team of ten.

In the end, he picked Sylara, the vampire demoness. She is dangerous, and considering this is destined to be a bloodbath, she is the right fit. She will grow stronger from the blood she absorbs, but she will also have fun.

The second is, of course, Zareth. Kaizo needed someone who could invoke the fear of death in the hearts of these Dark Elves. With his power to command the Void Dragon and the World Serpent, Kaizo knew he would come in handy.
Selene was also added. She would be in charge of rescuing Dia.
Since they had received this mission, it means Dia is still alive. So she and Vari would work together to rescue her.
They are both sisters with Unity, so this mission is personal.
The next person he added to his team is the Shade King Nykali. He wants his wraith army, so he added him to it. He also added Veera and Yi Lai to the team.

Although Yi Lai only has two undead dragons, she is both a fighter and a necromancer, so she is perfect for this battle. Her two undead dragons would come in handy. Veera, however, has many powerful undead.
The last two additions were, of course, Neomi and Camila.
Once the team was formed, they left atop Yi Lai’s undead dragon. The speed of the dragon is several times faster, allowing them to travel faster.
Even so, from what Veera had seen through the memories of the undead Dark Elves, it would take them a couple of hours to reach the city where Dia was taken to.
Meanwhile, Dia had already been thrown into a dark, small cell after being tortured for three days. Her limbs were tied with a chain reinforced with several complex enchantments.

Whenever she tries to break free, the chains tighten their hold on her, making it virtually impossible to free herself. In fact, if she were to continue, it would get to the point where her limbs would be tightened until they fall off.
So she just sat there, leaning against the wall as she examined what had happened over the last few days and what she could have done to prevent it.
Three days ago, they had just gone to save seven Elven children from a band of Dark Elf Bandits and were on their way back to the rebel sanctuary when they were ambushed.
Luckily, she was able to lock down the enemy for five seconds, allowing the rest of her people to leave.
As for the one who betrayed them, while he regretted it, she had to kill him first and burn his body to ashes to prevent the location of their sanctuary from falling into the wrong hands.
They had made it in such a way that whenever they leave the base, its location would be wiped from everyone’s minds except hers.
Unless she transmits it back to them, there is no way one can know where to even look. This was why she killed the traitor. She had already transmitted the location before the ambush.
Perhaps if the traitor were still alive, she might have had a chance to escape. But with him dead, they need her to know where the sanctuary is.
They want her dead, but their interest is more in knowing the location of the Rebel Sanctuary.

It had already been three days, but they couldn’t get anything from her. They would try again tomorrow, and if she remained stubborn, they would kill her and hang her head at the entrance of the city just like they did with the dozens that came before her.
Unaware that help is on the way, she sat in wait for her death.
A few minutes later, someone walked into the prison cell and stopped when they were three feet from her.
"Clearly you didn’t see this day coming, did you?" The person who spoke is a female; however, her voice is hoarse and eerie.
"I would like you to know your death will happen tomorrow morning instead of the evening. I decided to escalate things since the longer you remain alive, the more disgusting it gets to look at you."

Clearly, this person has some vendetta against Dia, so they are coming down hard on her. However, as someone who had been training her mind since teenagehood, she knew when to be angry and when to remain calm.
"You dare kill my brother in cold blood when he begged for mercy."
"He died because he killed a pregnant mother and children. I would have slit your throat too if it wasn’t for the timely intervention from your king and his band of useless soldiers."
Dia said with a chuckle, then she added, "If you are going to kill me, then go ahead. I have nothing to lose."
The lady gritted her teeth in frustration.

She remained there for a few minutes before a sigh escaped her lips. "We have already captured one of your men. He refuses to talk, but with the right pain, we will soon get the location of your sanctuary.

Tomorrow morning, you will be cut to pieces using the Venom Fang blade. Enjoy the rest of your night knowing that after you are dead, mothers and children who thought they were safe in your care will follow swiftly."
Dia growled, but she could do nothing. Tears flowed down her face, her heart breaking even more.
However, before she could start to sob—something the lady would love to hear and see—a voice thundered in the city, causing everyone to become alert and look up.
"Here I come."

chapters.title: Chapter 1355: The Seventh Floor - GladiaDom (3)
paragraphs: If there is anything both beautiful and dangerous, then it is the sight of Kaizo bathed in golden lightning descending from the clouds like a collapsing mountain.
Every last Dark Elf scattered, considering the kind of danger falling down on them.
BOOOOMMMM
Kaizo landed hard, and with it, a large part of the city cracked and crumbled, sending dust and a shockwave everywhere.

However, before the dust settled, a powerful roar came from the air, followed by the silhouette of a giant dragon moving through the clouds. Then, powerful pressure descended as a colossal serpent emerged from the cloud.
Both the dragon and the serpent descended, and everyone felt their bodies pressed down. Zareth stood on the dragon’s back, his hand folded behind him, as flames and destruction rocked the city.
Wraiths of various shapes and sizes also appeared, their wailing sounds sending chills down everyone’s spines.
Kaizo came with a thunderous boom, and Zareth came with a bone-crushing pressure. Shade King Nykali, however, descended with horror. But he wasn’t the only one.

When Veera appeared, she was followed by over a thousand angels and demons. Before she met Kent, she had only undead demons under her command. However, after the battle in the Paragon Universe, she got thousands of angels.

Naturally, Kent taught her quality over quantity, so she went all in and, using many of the dead bodies she had collected in the paragon universe, she created a superior undead army, each a terror to run from.
So when she appeared with 1200 undead, chaos broke out everywhere.

The Dark Elves weren’t prepared for this kind of assault. They knew the Elves wouldn’t dare attack them this boldly. So when Kaizo and his team came in hard, they were quickly disorganised—something Kaizo aimed for.
Before they could form a counter, the battle had already become chaotic, leaving this disorganized.
"Lady Selene and Lady Vari, please get to work," Kaizo said before he jumped back into battle. Everywhere he passed, bodies kept exploding, as if made of ice.
"Let’s go, dear," Vari took Selene’s hand, and they vanished into the shadows. Sylara, Neomi, Yi Lai, and Camilla also entered combat mode and started killing.
They came to rescue someone precious to their sister, so they weren’t holding back their strength, not even for a moment.

Meanwhile, in the underground prison, Dia sat on the same spot, a smug smile playing on her lips. She didn’t know who was brave enough to attack the Dark Elves’ main headquarters, but she is happy it is happening.
The lady who came to inform her of their plan for her the next day now looks restless with every explosion and scream, causing her body to twitch.
She suddenly retrieved a communication jade and contacted someone. "What is going on up there?"
"We are under attack by unknown assailants. Lord Pilio wants all hands on deck, so kill that bitch and get your ass over here."
"Okay, General."
The moment she put away her communication jade, a dagger appeared in her hands, and she started walking toward Dia.
"So even that loser seems restless, even calling all hands on deck, huh. I suppose I would be dying knowing you would follow soon enough," Dia said with a smile.
As someone who had fought many harrowing battles, she knew the battle happening above ground was more than the Dark Elves were making it look.
The command given to the lady is just too urgent for her to try to delay her killing, considering she wanted Dia dead for years now.
"Killing you is everything I ever wanted. So even though I wouldn’t get to cut your body piece by piece, piercing your eye, then through to your brain would do the trick,"
She stopped before Dia, who held a smile on her face. In her mind, after this battle, the Dark Elves would have something more to worry about than the rebel force.
"Die, bitch." Her dagger moved toward Dia’s eye, aiming to kill her quickly so she could go back out there and aid her king.
However, just when the dagger was mere inches away, a deadly scythe appeared, and its sharp blades pressed against her throat...
"I am afraid you cannot kill her." Vari’s sweet voice entered her ear before the scythe moved, taking her head off.
Dia froze in shock, unsure of how to process what had just happened.
"As expected of Unity’s sister, she is both beautiful and brave," Selene said, walking toward Dia with a smile playing on her lips.
"Hi, my name is Selene, and this is my sister Vari. We have been sent to save you." Without giving her the chance to even respond, Selene clenched the chain around her arm.
Her palm glowed silver; then, like metal plastic, the chain melted, freeing her arms. She then melted the ones binding her legs.
"Who sent you?" Dia asked.
"Even if we tell you, you are not going to believe us," Vari said, sheathing her scythe on her back...
"Try me," Dia said, dual curved blades appearing in her firm grip.
Selene looked at Vari, who shrugged. "Well, your sister from your past life sent us."
Dia furrowed her brow, staring between Selene and Vari. A few seconds later, she sighed. "You are right, I don’t believe you. But thank you for saving me," Dia said and started to move.
"Huh, do you have somewhere else to be?" Vari asked.
"Yes. I want that bastard dead, so now that I am within the city, which is under attack, if I don’t take advantage of it, then I might as well offer my head to them."
"Oh, beautiful, brave, and resourceful." Selene giggled, feeling rather excited. "You and I are going to be best friends."
She grabbed Dia’s hand, and they sped off, leaving Vari behind. She shook her head. "Poor soul. Selene is going to corrupt her innocent mind."

After letting out a chuckle, she also left. It seems the rescue mission has now turned into babysitting. If what Dia wanted was to kill the King of the Dark Elves, then that is what they are going to help her do.

Thankfully, Kaizo and the others are doing better than one would hope. With Veera and Nykali joining the battle with all their undead and wraiths, the pressure was crashing down hard on the dark elves.
After all, every last wraith under Nykali’s command and every undead under Veera’s command are all at the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage.
Selene led Dia through the chaotic battlefield, cutting down every Dark Elf they met. Their target is hiding in a building several km away from the main battlefield.
He was issuing commands while seated comfortably on his throne, unaware that three lethal beauties were coming after him.

"Where is Zonu?" a Dark Elf with brown hair and deep red eyes asked, his fist thundering on the arm of his throne. His name is Pilio, the Dark Elf King, who was responsible for the death of millions of Elves.
Another Dark Elf standing not far from him trembled, bowing toward him. "My lord, I have already informed her of the situation, so I am sure she is on her way here as we speak."
"PILIO, GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE AND ACCEPT YOUR DEATH!"
Before Pilio could respond to his subordinate’s words, a chilling female voice called from the outside, causing everyone to go on high alert.

Every last Dark Elf scattered, considering the kind of danger falling down on them.
BOOOOMMMM
Kaizo landed hard, and with it, a large part of the city cracked and crumbled, sending dust and a shockwave everywhere.
However, before the dust settled, a powerful roar came from the air, followed by the silhouette of a giant dragon moving through the clouds.
Then, powerful pressure descended as a colossal serpent emerged from the cloud.
Both the dragon and the serpent descended, and everyone felt their bodies pressed down.
Zareth stood on the dragon’s back, his hand folded behind him, as flames and destruction rocked the city.
Wraiths of various shapes and sizes also appeared, their wailing sounds sending chills down everyone’s spines.
Kaizo came with a thunderous boom, and Zareth came with a bone-crushing pressure.
Shade King Nykali, however, descended with horror.
But he wasn’t the only one.
When Veera appeared, she was followed by over a thousand angels and demons.
Before she met Kent, she had only undead demons under her command.
However, after the battle in the Paragon Universe, she got thousands of angels.

Naturally, Kent taught her quality over quantity, so she went all in and, using many of the dead bodies she had collected in the paragon universe, she created a superior undead army, each a terror to run from.
So when she appeared with 1200 undead, chaos broke out everywhere.
The Dark Elves weren’t prepared for this kind of assault.
They knew the Elves wouldn’t dare attack them this boldly.
So when Kaizo and his team came in hard, they were quickly disorganised—something Kaizo aimed for.
Before they could form a counter, the battle had already become chaotic, leaving this disorganized.
"Lady Selene and Lady Vari, please get to work," Kaizo said before he jumped back into battle.
Everywhere he passed, bodies kept exploding, as if made of ice.
"Let’s go, dear," Vari took Selene’s hand, and they vanished into the shadows.
Sylara, Neomi, Yi Lai, and Camilla also entered combat mode and started killing.
They came to rescue someone precious to their sister, so they weren’t holding back their strength, not even for a moment.
Meanwhile, in the underground prison, Dia sat on the same spot, a smug smile playing on her lips.
She didn’t know who was brave enough to attack the Dark Elves’ main headquarters, but she is happy it is happening.
The lady who came to inform her of their plan for her the next day now looks restless with every explosion and scream, causing her body to twitch.
She suddenly retrieved a communication jade and contacted someone.
"What is going on up there?"
"We are under attack by unknown assailants.
Lord Pilio wants all hands on deck, so kill that bitch and get your ass over here."
"Okay, General."
The moment she put away her communication jade, a dagger appeared in her hands, and she started walking toward Dia.
"So even that loser seems restless, even calling all hands on deck, huh.
I suppose I would be dying knowing you would follow soon enough," Dia said with a smile.
As someone who had fought many harrowing battles, she knew the battle happening above ground was more than the Dark Elves were making it look.
The command given to the lady is just too urgent for her to try to delay her killing, considering she wanted Dia dead for years now.
"Killing you is everything I ever wanted.
So even though I wouldn’t get to cut your body piece by piece, piercing your eye, then through to your brain would do the trick,"
She stopped before Dia, who held a smile on her face.
In her mind, after this battle, the Dark Elves would have something more to worry about than the rebel force.
"Die, bitch." Her dagger moved toward Dia’s eye, aiming to kill her quickly so she could go back out there and aid her king.
However, just when the dagger was mere inches away, a deadly scythe appeared, and its sharp blades pressed against her throat...
"I am afraid you cannot kill her." Vari’s sweet voice entered her ear before the scythe moved, taking her head off.
Dia froze in shock, unsure of how to process what had just happened.
"As expected of Unity’s sister, she is both beautiful and brave," Selene said, walking toward Dia with a smile playing on her lips.
"Hi, my name is Selene, and this is my sister Vari.
We have been sent to save you." Without giving her the chance to even respond, Selene clenched the chain around her arm.
Her palm glowed silver; then, like metal plastic, the chain melted, freeing her arms.
She then melted the ones binding her legs.
"Who sent you?" Dia asked.
"Even if we tell you, you are not going to believe us," Vari said, sheathing her scythe on her back...
"Try me," Dia said, dual curved blades appearing in her firm grip.
Selene looked at Vari, who shrugged.
"Well, your sister from your past life sent us."
Dia furrowed her brow, staring between Selene and Vari.
A few seconds later, she sighed.
"You are right, I don’t believe you.
But thank you for saving me," Dia said and started to move.
"Huh, do you have somewhere else to be?" Vari asked.
"Yes.
I want that bastard dead, so now that I am within the city, which is under attack, if I don’t take advantage of it, then I might as well offer my head to them."
"Oh, beautiful, brave, and resourceful." Selene giggled, feeling rather excited.
"You and I are going to be best friends."
She grabbed Dia’s hand, and they sped off, leaving Vari behind.
She shook her head.
"Poor soul.
Selene is going to corrupt her innocent mind."
After letting out a chuckle, she also left.
It seems the rescue mission has now turned into babysitting.
If what Dia wanted was to kill the King of the Dark Elves, then that is what they are going to help her do.
Thankfully, Kaizo and the others are doing better than one would hope.
With Veera and Nykali joining the battle with all their undead and wraiths, the pressure was crashing down hard on the dark elves.
After all, every last wraith under Nykali’s command and every undead under Veera’s command are all at the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage.
Selene led Dia through the chaotic battlefield, cutting down every Dark Elf they met.
Their target is hiding in a building several km away from the main battlefield.
He was issuing commands while seated comfortably on his throne, unaware that three lethal beauties were coming after him.
"Where is Zonu?" a Dark Elf with brown hair and deep red eyes asked, his fist thundering on the arm of his throne.
His name is Pilio, the Dark Elf King, who was responsible for the death of millions of Elves.
Another Dark Elf standing not far from him trembled, bowing toward him.
"My lord, I have already informed her of the situation, so I am sure she is on her way here as we speak."
"PILIO, GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE AND ACCEPT YOUR DEATH!"
Before Pilio could respond to his subordinate’s words, a chilling female voice called from the outside, causing everyone to go on high alert.

chapters.title: Chapter 1356: The Seventh Floor - GladiaDom (4)
paragraphs: Every last Dark Elf in the building who heard the challenging command recognised whose voice it was. Many heard it after many encounters with her that ended with them running for their lives or her making a quick escape.
Others also heard her voice when she became their prisoner three days ago, through the gory torture they inflicted on her.
So, the moment Dia’s commanding, angry voice spread through the mansion, they knew what was about to happen.
Dozens rushed from the building, appearing outside with their weapons drawn. However, when they set their sights on two other ladies standing beside Dia, they held back.

Selene stood beside Dia, her sword already radiating an intense sword aura mixed with Celestial essence. Although she cannot wield Celestial essence just yet, her bloodline has about 0.2% Celestial qi that she can use.
At the moment, she was using about 0.001% of it, but that alone is evident in the deadly aura around her. Selene may have started out as someone with limited potential; however, she is a monster now.
Her power is enough to kill even a True Immortal if she has a sure chance to unleash just one sword attack. So she is a danger that cannot be ignored.

Vari, on the other hand, stood calmly, her scythe resting on her shoulder as she locked gazes with the Dark Elves now standing, their weapons drawn and ready to kill the one lady who had been a nuisance and thorn on their side for years.

"Although I have never seen this Pilio guy before, looking at your average faces, I believe his ugly ass is still hiding inside like a chick," Selene said, then she pointed her sword at the entrance of the mansion.
"I give to the count of three. If you don’t come out, I will cut this mansion in half."
"One."
The faces of the Dark Elves surrounding Selene, Vari, and Dia changed, anger and irritation appearing. They hate that a random person was just disrespecting their King, as if he meant nothing to her.
Three of them even charged forward, but before they could take three steps, Vari was already in motion, her deadly scythe cutting their heads off.
"Two."
It happened so fast that, the moment the move was made, the outcome of the battle was determined. It was just so sudden and rather anticlimactic.
"Three—"
Just when Selene counted three and was about to unleash her sword attack, five people appeared, Pilio leading them. His red eyes shone brighter, a wave of anger and evil intent filling his face.
"Why won’t you just die?" Pilio asked, but before he could swallow his breath, Dia moved, and he was singled out. She moved with a rather deadly speed, catching Pilio off guard.
The attack was aimed at his neck, but he managed to defend himself, and he even tried to counter. However, Dia hasn’t been training for years merely to lose to him in under a second.
She aimed to kill, so she went all in from the start, and the outcome soon revealed itself.
The others tried to go to their king’s aid; however, Vari and Selene blocked them.

"There are only two ways this plays out," Selene said, blocking the path of seven Dark Elves while Vari took eight. "It is either you run or die. However, running also means you must outrun my sister here."𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
She attacked the next second, giving them no chance to even decide on what they wanted. Of course, even if they chose to retreat, Vari is fast enough to take them all out.
The Dark Elves had killed millions of Elves, destroyed their homes, and made sure to make it so that even if one day they were gone, the vibrant elven home would be no more.
Naturally, that played out very well. However, what they never expected was a third party interfering in their battle that had lasted for thousands of years.
Dia had tried many times, lost many men in an attempt to kill Pilio, but she never succeeded. Today, she had finally gotten that chance. Thankfully, those backing her are not so simple at all.
On Kaizo’s side of the battlefield, thousands had already died.
Vari informed him and the others of Dia’s plan, so using the extended time they have, they are making sure every minute counts.
The plan was to attack, rescue Dia, and escape. However, given how things are going, they seem intent on conquering the entire city, which has already fallen into ruin.
Veera was using her necromancy abilities to the max, making sure every last Dark Elf that was killed by her undead or teammates rose up and joined the battle.
The more dead bodies appearing on the battlefield, the better for her.
[30 minutes later]
"Ha... ha... ha," Pilio panted, his entire body littered with cuts so grim he would need the strongest healer to save him.

The battle had only been going on for half an hour. However, he was beaten beyond recognition. If one were to say this person, now bleeding all over, is the Dark Elf King, many would find it ridiculous.
He had been reduced to a sorrowful state.
The aides whom he had relied on are all dead. Selene and Vari wasted no time killing every last one of them. Even those hidden were slaughtered by Vari, who likes to be thorough.
So, no help would be coming from anywhere. This also means that had it not been for his aides, Dia would have long succeeded in killing him.

She pointed one of her curved swords at him. "I was seven when I saw you slit my father’s throat with a broad smile on your face. At ten years old, I witnessed how you and your men violated my mother and sisters until they stopped breathing."

A tear fell from Dia’s eyes, but she held on to her resolve. "I became a cultivator because of you. I spent years training because I promised myself and my family that I would be the one to behead you.
Today, I finally have that chance. Today, I get to look down on you and stomp on your face."
BANG
Dia’s foot shot forward and landed a powerful kick on Pilio’s face, sending him crashing into a stone that hadn’t yet turned to powder. It exploded, sending debris flying everywhere.
COUGH COUGH
He coughed blood, his face showing the look of pain and fatigue.
"Today, I will behead you and hang your head at the gate of the city as a replacement for all the innocents you have killed.
But I won’t stop there. I will make sure your body is tossed into the devil’s maw, making sure even when in hell, you will never know peace."
With a few more drops of tears rolling down her face, she raised her sword and, with one fluid motion, Pilio’s head flew into the air and landed with a thud.
Dia dropped to the ground, tears streaming from her eyes. Soon, sobs entered.
She had started cultivating 1000+ years ago. In those precious years, she had never once rested. Everything she did all these years was so she could kill Pilio.
One could say the pain of losing her family and loved ones turned her bitter and vengeful. Thankfully, this time, she managed to kill her heart demon and freed herself.
Selene and Vari surrounded her and started consoling her.
Soon, the battle in the city came to an end, with every last Dark Elf slaughtered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1357: Sister Reunited (1)
paragraphs: It took some time to calm Dia down.
The moment she killed Pilio, it felt like a huge load had been taken off her. This brought back all the pent-up emotions she had buried deep in her heart over the years.
Now that she had avenged the entire elven race and her family, all forms of authority held by the Dark Elves had broken, freeing her to live a life of freedom.
Of course, there are still some dark elves in the other cities. However, they aren’t a threat, not when the head of their leader would be hanged at the entrance of the city soon.
So basically, she had nothing else to fear.
"Are you alright?" Selene asked, giving her a hand so she could stand up.
Dia nodded and turned to look at the headless body of the Dark Elf King she had killed. A few seconds later, a smile appeared on her face.
Yes, she had avenged her parents, loved ones, and every last Elf who fell to the sword of this wicked dark elf. They had caused so much damage, but now, their era of tyranny is over.
"Bastard." She stomped on the headless body.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
"Well, that is just overdoing it, Dia. He is already dead," Selene said, maintaining her usual giggle.
"Sorry. Even though he is dead, I still find him hateful and extremely ugly."
"He does look ugly by all standards. However, he is dead now, so why don’t we go back? I am sure your people would love to see you alive and well..."
"You are right." Dia nodded, then she turned and looked at Uncle Drew and the others, "But first, can you please help me free the other Elves still prisoners and slaves to the Dark Elves."
For a group of ten to be able to bring an entire city to its knees, Dia knew they were no simple people, so she had better take advantage of their generosity.

Of course, she also, in a strange way, knows Selene and the others would do anything she asks. It may be a gut feeling, but she knew they would help, no matter what she asked of them, as long as it was not below their moral code.
"About that," Selene turned to Vari, who merely gave her a nod.
Selene nodded and reached out to Vexthra. A second later, the whole gang teleported to the city, startling Dia.

However, what shook her even more was the blonde who jumped into her arms and started crying all over her chest. Unity’s speed was just too fast for her to track, so before she knew it, she was crying on her chest.
Dia is taller than Unity, so her face was between her boobs, soaking her wet. Despite the bloodstains and the dirt on her clothes, Unity didn’t seem to care.
Dia was startled.

However, before she could even think about wiggling her way out of Unity’s arms, a feeling of love and happiness suddenly assaulted her, making her stop pushing away and start patting Unity on the back instead.
She didn’t understand where those feelings came from, but she didn’t hate them.
After about 10 minutes, Unity finally calmed down. Still, with tears rolling down her face, she raised her head and looked at Dia’s face.
"I-I missed you so much, sister."

Dia tried to raise her brow and perhaps say she had no sister left, that both her sisters and parents were brutally murdered. However, those words vanished from her mind, and the only thing she could think about or feel was how happy she was at the moment.
Unity already had memories of her past life as Artemis, so she knew the face staring at her was her sister, Hera. She knew deep within her that she was her.

Dia, on the other hand, had no idea who Unity was. However, deep within her, she knew this lady was important to her. But even if Unity is nothing to her, the fact that she soaked her clothes with her tears made her know she was going through some things, so it is better to consider her feelings for now.
This was even why she let a smile appear on her face: "You are so beautiful," she said, making Unity smile as well.
"You are also beautiful. Just a little bit dirty..."

"Yeah. I was captured and tortured for three days, so I never had time to bathe and change clothes." Dia’s smile brightened, unaware that just by talking with Unity, her personality from her past life was slowly resurfacing.
Unity took her hand and turned toward her sister, "You have already met Selene and Vari."
Dia nodded...
"The rest are all my sisters and friends. This is my big sister Vexthra. Aside from my husband, she is the next most important person in my life."

"Really, Unity..." The rest of her sisters protested, clearly feeling that Unity is a bit biased. Vexthra, on the other hand, was very happy to hear what Unity said. She may be a goddess, but when with her sisters, she is rather down to earth.

Unity merely smiled and spent the next couple of minutes introducing everyone. Her family is big and lively, so she made sure Dia understood the kind of people she would be spending time with from now on.
"Thank you all for coming to my aid when I desperately needed it."

"Don’t worry about it, Dia," Vexthra said, stepping forward. She took her other hand and spoke in a reassuring tone, "Now that we are here, we will do everything in our power to make sure you and your people are forever free from the tyranny of all who seek to destroy."
Dia nodded.
Vexthra turned toward Uncle Drew, "The mission is now complete, so the restriction has been lifted. As long as you don’t use your demigod powers, you are free to kill as many as you want.
Go to this marked place and make sure every last dark elf is slaughtered. Save the Elves and bring them to this city for migration into the tower."
"Migration?" Dia asked with a raised brow.
"Yes, sis, this place is ruined, so we are relocating you and everyone to a much more beautiful place. Of course, we will first take you there, and if you like it, then we can proceed."

Dia looked around for a few minutes before she nodded. She could see the state of the city, and, as people who prefer nature and beauty, this place is neither hygienic nor suitable for them to live in.
"Alright, get to work."
Uncle Drew took charge from Kaizo and started dividing the teams into 12, since they had to attack 12 places. A minute later, all 12 teams had been formed.
"See you later, Dia," Selene said before jumping onto one of Yi Lai’s undead dragons, and they left. All twelve teams used mounts.
Soon, only Unity, Elaine, Vexthra, and Dia remained. Elaine was healing her injuries while Unity merely kept holding her.
As for Vexthra, she knew she had to commission Gaia to expand Nature City to accommodate the new Elves they would be bringing into the Tower.
A few minutes later, the four of them vanished and appeared in the Mountain Garden, where Gaia and her band of troublemakers were having a tea party.

However, unlike Dia’s effect on Kent, my heart demon makes it impossible for me to kill him, so you can say the reason why I wanted Kent to become strong is to help me kill him.

Because of my hatred, I became somebody else. I have also narrowly escaped death because of a heart demon. However, Kent had no such chance... He had suffered for many years because he never had the chance to explain his side of the story.
So I think he should be given the chance to tell his side of the story."
Vexthra chuckled. "Trust me, hatred is a complex emotion. It has a way of destroying everything about you and everything around you.
So embrace this life you have and live it on your own terms. It is not too late to turn things around." Vexthra sighs and then smiles.
She is the Goddess of Hatred and Resentment, so when it comes to hate, she knows everything about it. She understood how it can affect a person, even to the point of destroying them.
So she hopes Dia would do the right thing. This is both to save herself and, hopefully, save Kent.

Vexthra nodded. She is happy this is finally happening...

"I suppose you are Dia, or do you prefer I call you Hera?"
Dia stood frozen, stunned for a few minutes before she responded with a forced smile. "Dia is fine."
"Well, Dia, you can call me Kent... Kent Madson."

chapters.title: Chapter 1363: Apologies
paragraphs: Dia and Kent stood facing each other with unblinking expressions for a few seconds before Kent walked toward her and took her hand.
Dia made no attempt to resist. She came to apologise, so she allowed Kent to hold her. Soon, they began floating up.
A few seconds later, they stopped at the rounded end of the hilt of the Sword of Enlightenment. This allowed them to see the vast and beautiful expanse of the Sword Tower.
"I hope you are not afraid of heights," Kent said, a small smile playing on his lips.
"I am fine. It is not like I will die if I were to fall now."
"Good then." Kent allowed the wind to blow past them.
The curse had already been triggered. However, he sensed something else that made him wonder many things. But before diving into that, he first had something to say to Dia.
"Vexthra told me about you and what I have caused you—"
Before Kent could get into anything, Dia stopped him. "You don’t have to apologise, Kent. I have already learned what happened, and I know I was at fault — I am at fault."

Kent smiled. "That is the thing, Dia. I believe it was my fault Artemis died. It is indeed true that I was grieving back then. I had just lost someone dear to me at the hands of the forsaken race, so I was extremely angry.

However, while I should have been the kind of person my beloved wanted me to be, I became emotionless and detached. She wanted me to be happy and live an empathetic life. However, a second after she died, I became the old me... I became cold and ruthless,
Artemis came into my life with something unique, something I should have held dear.
But instead of accepting her, I became distant and even paid no attention to her. She just wanted to be my friend, but I ignored her.
So it was a fault. If I had just opened a small part of my heart and accepted her, maybe she wouldn’t have died. And if she had never died, you wouldn’t have become who you became."
"Maybe," Dia said, turning to face Kent. "Isn’t that a funny word. Maybe, what if... these are words we only speak when bad things happen.
Maybe if you had accepted Artemis, she wouldn’t have died. However, you seem to have forgotten something.
Back then, you were also grieving, and while it would have been nice to be a bit more accommodating, you weren’t in the right frame of mind.

But I was. I was perfectly fine. I knew what had happened. I heard what these people did. However, instead of going after them, I came after you instead. I tapped into my hatred and did many despicable things just to get to you.

I had the chance to take a step back. I had the chance to stop and grieve like the rest of my family. However, I did the opposite. I did to others what those people did to me. I killed innocents, leaving their families grieving them also.

And for what? Just to kill the one person who didn’t deserve any of this? I really am sorry, Kent. If I had known, maybe I would have done the opposite. I would have grieved like everybody else." Dia’s tears began to roll down her face.
However, Kent moved closer and wiped them.
"I am fine, Dia. I don’t blame you for anything, so you shouldn’t blame yourself." He used his thumb to wipe a new teardrop.
Dia reeled into her emotions and went in for a hug, her face pressed against his shoulder...
"Bad things happen to innocent people all the time. So don’t blame yourself. If anything, be grateful for this new life you have and live it to the max.
Trust me, inside the Tower, you will get anything you need for free. You will be safe here and even get to live with your sister and the girls."
Kent isn’t angry that her presence has triggered the curse. If anything, he is happy he wouldn’t have to kill her, since they seem to be on the same page.
Dia was too caught up in her emotions to make a sound. However, she managed to nod.

"Also, sorry about the claw through the heart part, and perhaps the other times I have killed you." Kent ended with a little laugh, making Dia smile. She pulled her head back and stared at his handsome face.
"I am mad about that part. I can only imagine how painful that was..." She smiled, then added, "I actually knew since I have all my memories back. It was painful like hell."
Kent cupped her cheek. "In my defence, you also tried to kill me and even came this close to killing me. So I call it self-defence."
Dia smirked. "I guess you are right. But now that you said it, I can only imagine how painful that would have been."
"I guess we will never know."
"I guess so too."
They stared at each other for a few seconds before bursting out in laughter. Kent turned her around and hugged her from behind.
He opened the soul map and linked it to Dia.
"How typical," she muttered, watching Unity and the rest of her sisters spying on them. "Artemis had always been a nosy kid." She smiled.
"She is sweet, though," Kent said, and Dia nodded.
"That she is. Everybody loves her, something she always used to get me in trouble. Such a bitch."
Dia smiled, feeling happy she managed to get things sorted out with Kent. It wasn’t awkward like she had expected.
Far in the distance, hidden behind the Sword World building, Vexthra, Unity, Selene, and Elaine looked toward Kent and Dia with satisfied smiles on their faces.

"If I had known, I would have made Dia wear a thin gown. That would have allowed Kent’s dick to fall perfectly between her butts." Selene said, a bit pained now that she was seeing the position Kent and Dia were in.

"Sorry, Selene, your time will come," Vexthra consoled her. Then she turned to Unity, "She is fine, so I guess we have overstayed our welcome. Knowing Kent, despite the tower’s assistance, he might have already seen us."
"Yeah, we should go. The longer we stay, the more creepy we become."
"Too bad with the clothes," Selene said. "I will plan better next time and make sure their second date goes well."
"Selene, get your head out of your ass. This is not a date." Elaine landed a knock on Selene’s head before grabbing her. The next second, they were inside the love garden in the harem tower.
And as if the heavens were showing mercy on her, the moment they arrived, Miryssa woke up, her body still dirty from the marathon she had with Kent.
When she sensed Selene’s presence, she ran and hid inside the bathroom. However, now that she was in the harem, the shameless sword saintess merely teleported into the bathroom.
Miryssa regretted the day she met Selene. However, now that she knew what Selene was capable of, she could only look forward to when a different prey would fall into her hands.
She may be a goddess, but even she is afraid of what Selene is capable of using merely her words.
But she is happy to have finally become Kent’s wife. This means she would receive her True Name. But even if she doesn’t have some, Kent can just give her one as he did with Vexthra.

chapters.title: Chapter 1364: Call Me Mother-In-Law
paragraphs: "This place is beautiful," Dia said, Kent holding her hand as they walked down the street of Gaiaville. As they pass by, the humans and the others living there keep staring at them with happy expressions.
Kent is like a god to them, so seeing him walk around with a beauty made them happy for him.
After their emotional heart-to-heart, Kent decided to show her around the tower.

Their first stop was Gaiaville, where he showed her all the beautiful stuff Gaia and her sisters built. As someone born into a war-torn world, she had never seen a peaceful, beautiful place like the one in the tower.
So she was mesmerized by it all.
It is like a fantasy to her and everyone from her world.

But her surprise didn’t end there. Kent took her to Blood City, then to the floating city where the Sky Foxes live, before finally taking her to Nature, where the Elves from his mom’s world and her world live now.
They have the highest population in all 4 cities. Of course, some of the humans, Sky Foxes, and even the Bloodveins had started dating, so there are mixed races in the cities they had visited.
In a couple of years, hybrid beings would start popping up in the tower cities.
The idea is to build a functioning society in the tower and ensure life is as peaceful and simple as possible.
"So, everyone living here doesn’t have to pay for anything. You basically provide for them," Dia asked, stopping under a tree that had created a canopy of shade. "How are you financing everything?"

Kent smiled and started leading her away as he answered her question, "The idea is to make sure everyone has everything, of course. However, I have made it so the more people that live here, the more income I earn from their presence."

Dia looked at Kent for a few seconds and smiled, "That is bullshit, and you know it. However, since you don’t want to tell me, I wouldn’t insist. Just know that my people and I are eternally grateful."
"No need for that. Like I said, the more people living here, the better for all of us. For now, it will depend on how much they want to coexist with everyone here."
"They will adapt, Kent. We have adapted for years, so I know they will too now that we have peace and quiet."
Kent nodded to her words.
Right now, he has done his part by making sure there is a place to accommodate them. He had already made them as comfortable as they could be.
Of course, there is the part where her people, who had been at war for many years, would learn to live with the peaceful beings living in the various cities.

There will be fights and conflicts; however, as long as there is order in the end, he wouldn’t mind. Gaia had prepared for everything, so he knew even if there was a major battle between the various races, the damage would be minimal.
"Don’t worry, Dia, they would be fine. Now, why don’t we go see someone very special to me?" They soon headed deeper into the city.
A few minutes later, they appeared in front of a small mansion surrounded by a beautiful garden. Inside one of the gardens, a blue-haired beauty sat drinking tea.
"Mom, guess who is back?" Kent said, walking into the garden with Dia still in his arms. Hearing him call the beautiful lady Mom made her raise her brow a bit.
"Kent, and here I thought you had forgotten I exist." Lady Enyo said, her expression brightening. When she turned and met Dia’s gaze, her smile bloomed.
"I have been busy, Mom. It is not easy running four big cities and still finding time to handle other stuff." Kent laughed, then he took the tea from his mother and sipped it.
She didn’t mind him drinking her tea. Kent is her world, so allowing him to behave mischievously is something she doesn’t mind.

"Come here, darling," Lady Enyo, of course, took Dia’s hand and pulled her into a hug. She then asked Kent a question, "Are you sure you didn’t come because you were spending ’quality’ time with your women?"
"Haha, Mom, very funny. But no, I was busy, though I have to say, the past couple of days had been me teaching a goddess her place and putting her to bed, if you know what I mean."
Lady Enyo smirked and muttered, "Shameless pervert."
She turned to Dia, "What is your name, darling?"
"Dia,"
"Well, Dia, I am Lady Enyo, but you can just call me Mother-in-Law."
Dia smiled innocently hearing what Lady Enyo said... "Mom, please, Dia and I are friends, okay? She is Unity’s sister."
"I suppose that can be seen in her beauty. But when does that ever stop you? You are not yet an Immortal, yet you already have over 20 wives. Adding one more is nothing at this point."
"What do you say, Dia? Do you like my son?" Lady Enyo asked, making Dia shy. She hadn’t really thought to that point, so she had no answer.
She only wanted to apologize to Kent. Aside from that, she had nothing else, especially not any plans to become his woman. So the question posed to her isn’t one she could answer.
"Mom, she is just a friend, so stop scaring her."
"If you say so. Just know that I wouldn’t mind having her become one of the many mothers of my grandchildren."
"Talking about grandchildren, when are you giving me one?"
"They will come, Mom. They will come to the point you wouldn’t even be able to carry them," Kent said with a smile before changing the topic. He knew his mom better than anyone.
She would keep on going on about grandchildren until she was tired. So he stopped her before things got out of control. This, in a way, saved Dia from the embarrassing situation.
Thankfully, they had a productive conversation after the initial shameless awkwardness. They spent a couple of hours with his mom before going back to the Harem Tower.
He still has some stuff to do, so after leaving Dia with Vexthra and the others, he left. Vexthra would be taking her with them to the 8th floor of the dungeon.
But first, they made sure she answered all their questions to the T.
In fact, Selene went a bit over the top, making sure Dia told her all she had experienced so she could come up with the best way for her to get inside Kent’s pants.
Learning how Kent treated her made them wonder whether he liked her or if she was indeed just a friend, as he said. So they wanted to make sure their next meeting would go as well as it could.
In the end, they concluded that Kent needed some time to process things. He has a lot on his plate now, so giving him some space is the best move.
On the other hand, after Kent got back to the Sword Tower, he took his time to analyse all that had happened and came to a single conclusion.
"As long as she is close to me, I don’t feel anything. This is a good thing. I just have to keep her close so that when things become painful, I can at least endure."
Unbeknownst to Kent, Dia had also come to a similar conclusion, "I can feel his pain. This means the closer I am to him, the better. Maybe I can even take all of it and endure it for him."

The idea is to build a functioning society in the tower and ensure life is as peaceful and simple as possible.
"So, everyone living here doesn’t have to pay for anything.
You basically provide for them," Dia asked, stopping under a tree that had created a canopy of shade.
"How are you financing everything?"
Kent smiled and started leading her away as he answered her question, "The idea is to make sure everyone has everything, of course.
However, I have made it so the more people that live here, the more income I earn from their presence."
Dia looked at Kent for a few seconds and smiled, "That is bullshit, and you know it.
However, since you don’t want to tell me, I wouldn’t insist.
Just know that my people and I are eternally grateful."
"No need for that.
Like I said, the more people living here, the better for all of us.
For now, it will depend on how much they want to coexist with everyone here."
"They will adapt, Kent.
We have adapted for years, so I know they will too now that we have peace and quiet."
Kent nodded to her words.
Right now, he has done his part by making sure there is a place to accommodate them.
He had already made them as comfortable as they could be.
Of course, there is the part where her people, who had been at war for many years, would learn to live with the peaceful beings living in the various cities.
There will be fights and conflicts; however, as long as there is order in the end, he wouldn’t mind.
Gaia had prepared for everything, so he knew even if there was a major battle between the various races, the damage would be minimal.
"Don’t worry, Dia, they would be fine.
Now, why don’t we go see someone very special to me?" They soon headed deeper into the city.
A few minutes later, they appeared in front of a small mansion surrounded by a beautiful garden.
Inside one of the gardens, a blue-haired beauty sat drinking tea.
"Mom, guess who is back?" Kent said, walking into the garden with Dia still in his arms.
Hearing him call the beautiful lady Mom made her raise her brow a bit.
"Kent, and here I thought you had forgotten I exist." Lady Enyo said, her expression brightening.
When she turned and met Dia’s gaze, her smile bloomed.
"I have been busy, Mom.
It is not easy running four big cities and still finding time to handle other stuff." Kent laughed, then he took the tea from his mother and sipped it.
She didn’t mind him drinking her tea.
Kent is her world, so allowing him to behave mischievously is something she doesn’t mind.
"Come here, darling," Lady Enyo, of course, took Dia’s hand and pulled her into a hug.
She then asked Kent a question, "Are you sure you didn’t come because you were spending ’quality’ time with your women?"
"Haha, Mom, very funny.
But no, I was busy, though I have to say, the past couple of days had been me teaching a goddess her place and putting her to bed, if you know what I mean."
Lady Enyo smirked and muttered, "Shameless pervert."
She turned to Dia, "What is your name, darling?"
"Dia,"
"Well, Dia, I am Lady Enyo, but you can just call me Mother-in-Law."
Dia smiled innocently hearing what Lady Enyo said...
"Mom, please, Dia and I are friends, okay?
She is Unity’s sister."
"I suppose that can be seen in her beauty.
But when does that ever stop you?
You are not yet an Immortal, yet you already have over 20 wives.
Adding one more is nothing at this point."
"What do you say, Dia?
Do you like my son?" Lady Enyo asked, making Dia shy.
She hadn’t really thought to that point, so she had no answer.
She only wanted to apologize to Kent.
Aside from that, she had nothing else, especially not any plans to become his woman.
So the question posed to her isn’t one she could answer.
"Mom, she is just a friend, so stop scaring her."
"If you say so.
Just know that I wouldn’t mind having her become one of the many mothers of my grandchildren."
"Talking about grandchildren, when are you giving me one?"
"They will come, Mom.
They will come to the point you wouldn’t even be able to carry them," Kent said with a smile before changing the topic.
He knew his mom better than anyone.
She would keep on going on about grandchildren until she was tired.
So he stopped her before things got out of control.
This, in a way, saved Dia from the embarrassing situation.
Thankfully, they had a productive conversation after the initial shameless awkwardness.
They spent a couple of hours with his mom before going back to the Harem Tower.
He still has some stuff to do, so after leaving Dia with Vexthra and the others, he left.
Vexthra would be taking her with them to the 8th floor of the dungeon.
But first, they made sure she answered all their questions to the T.
In fact, Selene went a bit over the top, making sure Dia told her all she had experienced so she could come up with the best way for her to get inside Kent’s pants.
Learning how Kent treated her made them wonder whether he liked her or if she was indeed just a friend, as he said.
So they wanted to make sure their next meeting would go as well as it could.
In the end, they concluded that Kent needed some time to process things.
He has a lot on his plate now, so giving him some space is the best move.
On the other hand, after Kent got back to the Sword Tower, he took his time to analyse all that had happened and came to a single conclusion.
"As long as she is close to me, I don’t feel anything.
This is a good thing.
I just have to keep her close so that when things become painful, I can at least endure."
Unbeknownst to Kent, Dia had also come to a similar conclusion, "I can feel his pain.
This means the closer I am to him, the better.
Maybe I can even take all of it and endure it for him."

chapters.title: Chapter 1365: The Rewards
paragraphs: [Your Quest titled ’Void Temple Destruction’ has been completed successfully.]
[Rewards have been released into your inventory]
[Rewards]
↠ All debt owed to Karma would be cleared
↠ 50 Billion Tower Points
↠ Destiny Dream Key
↠ Five Memory Keys (Chaos, Jest, Faceless) & 2 Memory Keys for the Ruthless Bandit
↠ Absolute Life Coin
↠ Forsaken Records (1st Volume)
The quest was supposed to be very difficult. However, in the end, it turned out to be rather simple and a bit unexpected. But looking at the rewards, he knew he had struck it big.
Aside from his debt to Karma, he had now amassed quite a huge sum of tower points. "50 billion is a large sum of money, considering the amazing things I would be doing with it."

Kent smiles. He had indeed struck it big time this time around. Not only did he now have billions, but with the dungeons now being cleared, very soon, he would be swimming in billions of tower points.
Away from that, there is the Destiny Dream Key.
He retrieved a small golden key and appraised it...
[Destiny Dream Key]
[Description: Enter the dream of anyone you are destined with. Just think about them and press the Destiny Dream Key against your forehead.]
The first name that appeared in Kent’s mind is Elina. She is the only person that came to mind, so at the moment, he wanted nothing more than to see what she was dreaming about.
He had already located her through an item called the Destiny Map. This means he shares a destiny with her, and as such, this key would work for her too.
If he can enter her dream and assure her that he is alive and coming for her, perhaps that would lift her spirit a bit.
She might not remember him, but since he does, he knows the best way to let her know he is coming is to invade her dream and try his best.
The universe wants what is best for him, so he would, without a doubt, use the item.
However, before doing anything, he decided to check the rest of his rewards.
Aside from five memory keys for Jest, Chaos, and Faceless, he now gets to remember a different life, too, making it four out of 13.
He didn’t know why he was given the key, but learning that the Ruthless Bandit once entered the Star Gateway, he knew he had to remember something about him and see what made him a big shot.
The journey through the Star Gateway would be harrowing, so he at least wants to know something about this other part of himself before things get a bit complex.
[Absolute Life Coin]
[Description: Leave a trace of your soul in the Absolute Life Coin, which would preserve your life and grant you an additional chance at life even if your head was severed.]
"Wow, I didn’t see that coming," Kent muttered, looking at the Absolute Life Coin in his palm. "The ability to not die even if I die is unheard of."

He is literally getting a second life. So, if he were to die in this one, the coin would revive him. It is like the Life Ascension Pill, only that instead of swallowing it, he merely had to imbue it with his soul essence, and the rest would take care of itself.
This one is even guaranteed.
"Although I have no plans on dying, taking precautions isn’t bad at least."
He channeled his soul essence into it.
[You now have a second chance at Life]
Seeing the message, a smile appeared on his face. Kent didn’t want to jinx it, but while he had hoped the Void Temple was a difficult challenge, he wanted the Star Gateway to be easy.
Vexthra had already spoiled the danger level he would be facing, so he knew he had to be prepared. Having a second chance at life is good enough.
"What could go wrong?" He smiled and retrieved the last item in his rewards.

"The Forsaken Records," Kent muttered, already aware of what content is contained in the book in his hand. It has a red cover and a few tattered ropes falling from the edges. This gave it an eerie appearance and a bit of scare.
[Forsaken Records]
[Volume: One]
[Description: Know the history and hidden secrets of the forsaken race and what they represent.]

"I thought as much. However, what is there even to be worried about? I mean, they basically made first contact with the Void Beast, as per the records I have read, and let themselves be corrupted by it.
So there is nothing to even read about."

Kent hates the forsaken race so much that learning new things about them isn’t something he wants. To him, he already knows what there is to know about them, and that they all deserve to die.𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
He threw the book into his inventory and stopped thinking about it.
[The master may want to review the content in the book. There is no harm in learning something new about your enemies. There might even be something new and a way to go about handling them.]
Kent nodded, but he still didn’t take the book to read.
"I will need some time to handle that, Tower. For now, I have other things to worry about."

The more he learned about the forsaken race, the better he would understand them, as Tower said. However, it is not so simple for him. Most of his pain came from them throughout the many lives he had lived.
So his hatred for them is also very deep.
"I first have to use the Destiny Dream Key and use all the memory keys. That is more important to me now."

Entering Elina’s dream is something he never expected to happen to him now. He was supposed to go to her and take her home. However, since the process is a bit slow, the only way to reach her is to use a back door.
Kent retrieves the key and presses it against his forehead. The next second, he fell back and fell into a simple sleep.

Somewhere else, Elina had just returned from her shift, her entire body dirty. She quickly moved into a cave and cleaned herself. Then she changed into a new set of tattered clothes before entering her small cave.
She sat down beside a small girl who, despite her small arms and legs, also had a slave collar around her neck.

One might even ask why such a loli would look like a threat that had to be put on a leash. However, when born into slavery, the moment you come of age, you would be subjected to the same treatment as the adults.

She planted a kiss on her forehead, then she entered her own cave. Using her dirty work clothes as a pillow, she lay down on her bed. Her next shift starts in 5 hours, so catching some sleep is something all the slaves never joke with.
She lay on her back, her beautiful brown eyes staring at the roof of the cave. A few seconds later, a tear dropped from her eyes. However, she wiped it and turned to the side.
3 minutes later, she was deep asleep.
To her, those 5 hours of sleep are something she wanted mainly for one thing: to dream about the handsome dragon she always seems chummy with for reasons she had no idea of.

chapters.title: Chapter 1366: The Dream (1)
paragraphs: "Chaos, what are you doing out here?" Elina asked, walking toward a golden-haired, handsome dragon who seemed to be catching the attention of every lady who passed by.
"It is too noisy in there, Elina. I hate noise..."
Elina walked toward Chaos and pouted. She had painted her face rabbit, so her pout made her look rather cute.
"You are not fun, Chaos. I brought you here to have fun, but you are just too boring sometimes."
"Having fun is for weak people. I am not weak, nor would I reduce myself to their level. I hate weak people."
"So do you hate me?" Elina asked, her expression hardening. She brought Chaos to this festival with the hope of making him become more normal.
She wants him to be more than just the battle-hardened brute who was more focused on going from one battle to the next.
But even before she could start to teach him how to live like a normal person at a fun festival, he had already made up his mind not to listen to her suggestions.
"You are not a weak warrior, Elina. I saw you fight, and I know you are a powerful warrior."
"Then what makes you think the people here are weak?"
"Mundane activities are for weak people. I would prefer hunting and duels over face and body painting."

"This thick skull of yours is just too hard to get information inside." Elina grabbed his hand and tried to pull him by force. However, Chaos resisted. But she pulled again, and this time, he was pulled.
Many years ago, Elina tried many times to pull him, but Chaos remained standing like he was made of steel. However, now, it seemed things were different.
That was because just now, Chaos became Kent, and Elina became, well, Elina.
Just as it happened every time she dreamed, this time too, she had possessed the dream versions of Elina, and she would take advantage of the short time she had to talk to him.
That had been her life for many years now. She mostly dreamed about Elina and Chaos. Initially, it was merely her seeing them and hearing all they said.
She even followed them around many times. However, a couple of months ago, she started possessing Elina’s body.
It took her some time to get used to it.
Whenever she possesses her body, she knows exactly what to do and how to go about it.

So just now, when she pulled, and Chaos moved, she was taken aback. That wasn’t how it was supposed to be. She was supposed to spend the next hour using every means possible to drag him back to the festival.
The dreams come at random, with many being Elina making sure Chaos behaves normally, or more like teaching him to behave like a normal person.
So she was supposed to spend exactly 69 minutes convincing him using human logic before he agreed to go. But his accepting this early was never a part of the original script.
"Why did you stop?" Chaos, now possessed by Kent, asked. He did well to maintain his smug, unaffected expression.
"N-nothing. Just a bit surprised you gave in that easily."
"If I didn’t, you wouldn’t stop nagging me, so we might as well get this over with."
"What a baby," Elina said, going off script since the moment Chaos moved; the whole dream became something else.
What happened next would be hers, the same slave girl whose only source of entertainment is invading the dream of her past self, to decide.
"I am not going to paint my face, though."
"But that is the main theme of this festival."

"I know, but I am not going to paint my face, so don’t even try it," Kent tapped into what happened originally between him and Elina and decided to pick out points from that memory to avoid making it obvious.

Just now, when he decided to go with Elina, he saw the dream crack. This means that if he were to stray from the original dream or even make Elina aware that it isn’t a real dream, everything would come completely undone, and the dream would crumble.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
So he had to play his cards right.
He cannot tell Elina his real name, where he is from, who she is to him, or why he came to this dream. He would have to find a way to lift her spirit and keep her going for now.

After all, he can use the Destiny Dream Key more than once, so later he can come and continue where he stopped. It may be a different dream, but he would find a way to keep her engaged till he gets to her galaxy.
"You are very boring, Chaos. I never knew you were this boring, like I wouldn’t have brought you with me."
"Oh, then who would protect you and fly you around?"
"That is just stretching it, Chaos. Flying me around is a promise you made when I decided to become your friend."

Chaos stopped walking and looked at Elina, "I believe this is the point where you would say something like, how shameless. Weren’t you the same person begging me to become your friend after I killed your teammates?"
"Yeah, but you are the guy, so in human words, you begged me."
"I did not."
"Yes, you did."
"No, I did not."
"But you did."
"Fine, I will paint my face, but that is because I want to, not because I find you annoying and a bit childish."
Elina smiled, "The fact that you know when someone is childish means there is hope for you yet. You are not a lost cause."
They soon appeared in front of a painting store, where Chaos, with a frown on his face, had his face painted.
"How mundane," Chaos muttered after they left the shop.
Elina smiled and stared at him, "You are kind of cute. With your dragon horns on and how perfectly sculpted your face is, I say you will pass as my concubine." Elina said, giggling at the end.
"What is a concubine?"
"Nothing... Nobody. Let’s go, they are about to start the masquerade." Elina dragged him away, unaware that she was making Chaos (Kent) smile.
In the past, they missed it since Chaos refused to have his face painted. This made Elina promise not to take him to a masquerade festival ever again.
This time, however, they got to go.

Obviously, Elina, who had the previous Elina’s memories, was now thrilled to have witnessed this. She was born into a family of wealth, but due to jealousy and greed, she was sold into slavery to die there.
The first few years were extremely hard. However, she adapted, and with friends helping her move forward, she had come to accept her nature as a slave.
However, from the day she started dreaming about Elina and Chaos, she realised she was no slave. She had so much to live for, so becoming a slave isn’t something she would like.
And as days, weeks, and months passed, the defiant spirit, the kind that wouldn’t want to be branded a slave, only grew stronger.
She wants freedom. She wants the life Elina has. Today, she seems to be having just that.
And Kent, who was making all this happen, kept smiling inwardly.
