"But you did."
"Fine, I will paint my face, but that is because I want to, not because I find you annoying and a bit childish."
Elina smiled, "The fact that you know when someone is childish means there is hope for you yet.
You are not a lost cause."
They soon appeared in front of a painting store, where Chaos, with a frown on his face, had his face painted.
"How mundane," Chaos muttered after they left the shop.
Elina smiled and stared at him, "You are kind of cute.
With your dragon horns on and how perfectly sculpted your face is, I say you will pass as my concubine." Elina said, giggling at the end.
"What is a concubine?"
"Nothing...
Nobody.
Let’s go, they are about to start the masquerade." Elina dragged him away, unaware that she was making Chaos (Kent) smile.
In the past, they missed it since Chaos refused to have his face painted.
This made Elina promise not to take him to a masquerade festival ever again.
This time, however, they got to go.
Obviously, Elina, who had the previous Elina’s memories, was now thrilled to have witnessed this.
She was born into a family of wealth, but due to jealousy and greed, she was sold into slavery to die there.
The first few years were extremely hard.
However, she adapted, and with friends helping her move forward, she had come to accept her nature as a slave.
However, from the day she started dreaming about Elina and Chaos, she realised she was no slave.
She had so much to live for, so becoming a slave isn’t something she would like.
And as days, weeks, and months passed, the defiant spirit, the kind that wouldn’t want to be branded a slave, only grew stronger.
She wants freedom.
She wants the life Elina has.
Today, she seems to be having just that.
And Kent, who was making all this happen, kept smiling inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1367: The Dream (2)
paragraphs: "Wow, so beautiful." When they arrived at the festival ground, where all kinds of painted humans could be seen dancing and cheering, Elina became ultra-happy.
"Chaos, let’s go and dance."
"I would not do that."

"Suit yourself. I am going to have fun." Elina ran off. This is all non-scripted, so Chaos had no idea what to do next. However, Kent is not Chaos. He had grown past him and had been through all of these memories, so he knew what needed to be done.
Of course, there is also the issue of breaking the dream.
If there is one thing Elina is known for, then it is her shape. She had beautiful breasts and ass, the kind that would make any man turn their neck and head.

Chaos had broken a few of those heads and necks when the bond between him and Elina started strengthening. Whenever they went out, many men would try to shoot their shot with her, only for Chaos to shut them down.
Elina was a lively person. Wherever she was, there was joy and happiness. So she always attracted the wrong kind of crowd.
Kent knew things wouldn’t be different now. Even Elina, currently a slave, had assets that, had it not been for the rules placed on all slaves, many would have already tried to take advantage of her.

She is beautiful with heavy assets. So, watching her run off, Kent knew she would bring trouble. Chaos may not have noticed those ass shaking and boobs bouncing, but as someone who has over 25 women, he knew the kind of things men want.
"What a headache."
The handsome dragon had no choice but to follow her at a safe distance. Kent knew Chaos would never dance, so if he were to dance right now, the dream would break.
So it is better to play it safe. Elina’s happiness is what he was after, so if she is happy, which she is, considering how happy she looks, everything is worth it.

He stood on the side, his gaze locked on her as she had fun. Of course, now that he seemed to have a second chance with Elina, even if it were merely a dream, he kept staring at her butt and boobs. Chaos never had that desire back then.
Minutes passed, and while Elina would love for Chaos to come and dance with her, Chaos remained stubborn, though, deep in his heart, it pained him that he was limited in what he could do.

But protecting her while she had fun was, in a way, fun for him. Chaos protected her because she was her friend, or at least that was what she said. But Kent is doing it because she is someone very special to him.
All men who tried to look in her direction or move in her direction found themselves staring at a dangerous-looking dragon whose gaze alone was enough to kill their spirits.
Unbeknownst to Kent, Elina saw all this, and while she pretended not to see it, her happiness was coming from how protective Chaos was of her.𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶
She saw how he kept glaring at all the men coming her way. And considering her current life, this dream might just be the thing she needed to keep her going for a while.
After two hours, she became tired, so she pulled Chaos away to have dinner. Since Elina was rather rich, she booked a private room for them.
While inside, she couldn’t take her eyes off him.
"I believe this is what the humans call awkwardness. Can’t you just eat your food and stop staring at me?"
"I can’t help it. You look very handsome right now."
Chaos looked at her for a few seconds before turning to his food. If there is one thing he loves about the human world, then it is their food.
"Come on, Chaos. This is the part where you tell me I am also beautiful."
"But you are not. You painted your face like a rabbit; I have rabbits. I believe rabbits are ugly."
"You hate everything, Chaos. Aside from yourself, nobody is better in your eyes."
"As it should be. Dragons are superior to the other races."

Elina smirked and resumed eating. She understood Chaos more than he did himself, so she didn’t take some of his words to heart. But it was painful sometimes when Chaos acted directly opposite to how she wanted him to be.
"Who even calls themself Chaos. It is a terrible name."
"I like it," Chaos said with an indifferent expression.
"Of course you would like it. You are chaotic after all."
"It is my nature."
"How about my nature? I am calm, cheerful, and—"
"Annoying."
"I am not annoying," Elina pouted.
"Do I even have to tell you how many dangers you attracted when you were dancing? If I weren’t here, you would have long been dead."
Elina stared at Chaos for a few seconds before bursting out into resounding laughter.
"What is funny?"
"Wait a minute. You scared off all those people because you think they were a danger." Elina couldn’t hold back her laughter. It is very funny to the point that she laughed for a whole minute.
"You are such a baby, Chaos. I never knew you would be this gullible. To think you lack basic relationship skills, even branding flirt as danger... Just what cave did you crawl out from?"
Chaos said nothing. This had happened between them before. Elina had asked him why he always protected her from the men who made advances toward her, and his answer was that they were dangerous.
Back then, she laughed and explained some things to him. This time, too, she made sure to use the basic things around them to explain to him as if he were a child.

"Chaos, those people didn’t try to approach me because they wanted to hurt me. Unlike you, who have beautiful eyes but can’t see and appreciate my beauty, they saw me and wanted to have it for themselves.

You protecting me could be considered your way of expressing your feelings for me. Too bad you’re block-headed when it comes to things like this. What a waste of such a handsome face and strong body."
Elina chuckled and went back to her food.
’The explanation varied this time, but it is perfect to make my move,’

"Human emotions. How primitive..." Chaos smirked, and then he asked an unusual question, "Then, since I have protected you for nothing, does that mean I made a fool of myself? Also, what makes you move so differently?"
"You lack the eye of a predator, Chaos. If you had that predatory gaze, you would have long seen what I had been offering all this while."
Elina stood up and walked toward his chair and whispered into his ear, "Do you want a close-up performance, Mr. Dragon?"
"You seem desperate," Chaos said, causing Elina to blink and frown a bit. However, while she hid it, Kent saw through her facade...
"I am indeed desperate, Chaos. I love you, but your thick skull wouldn’t just open for you to see that." The dream cracked, then it started to crumble.
Chaos smirked and nodded, "Fine, you can dance."

chapters.title: Chapter 1368: End Of The Dream
paragraphs: In the original timeline, the dancing scene took place between Chaos and Elina several months after the masquerade festival.
After this festival, Elina would start making bold moves, like hugging him more, showing more skin, and even trying different ways to get into intimate positions with him.
One of those moments saw her dance for Chaos. Of course, the block-headed dragon bastard had no idea what she was trying to do.
However, that moment ignited something in him, and perhaps it was that something that made him become restless when he and Elina parted ways for a few months, leading to her death.
Now, seeing the dream crumbling, Kent asked her to dance, knowing full well it would escalate things. Naturally, he wasn’t about the pleasure of seeing that ass shake.
Now that he can remember everything, he has already enjoyed that sight.
He wanted to leave Elina with something, so he asked her to dance, and as someone who had been wanting to live like the Elina she kept dreaming about, she took the chance.

The dreaming was coming undone very quickly, but Elina was able to turn and start dancing. She kept all her dance moves to her waist and hips, shaking those heavy ass shake like they were made of water.
[Your dreaming would end in five seconds]
Kent smiled, and then he walked toward Elina, and just when the time reached the 3rd second, he reached and grabbed her ass, giving her a gentle squeeze before everything turned dark.
The next second, he woke up in the sword tower, a smile forming on his face.
He has only one Dream Key, so he had no plan to risk it.
He could have tried to tell Elina his true identity outright. However, he had no idea what would happen to the destiny dream key.
He knows the dreaming would crumble if he did that. But what then happens to the Dream Key if he were to go that extreme?

Obviously, he didn’t want to risk finding that out. So instead of telling her he was coming for her, he decided to make her happy while she waited. He wanted her to be happy, to go to sleep every day knowing she had someone to dream about.
It may sound like fiction, but having the ability to manipulate dreams is now within his reach, and just now, he left Elina with something to think about for the days ahead of her.
He cannot enter her dream again for another twenty days (outside time). That is a lot of time for her to miss him. However, with the gesture now, he knew she would be happy for a while.
This means he also has some time to handle the other stuff he needs to clear away.
"She would have her mind occupied for a while," Kent said, stretching his body. "Although I was limited by what I can do, using moments like this to keep her engaged is the best I can do for now.
"In three years, I will enter the star Gateway. I will fight my way to her, and hopefully, when we meet, I will find that she is having the best time of her life. She deserves that much."
Kent smiled, then he decided to handle the memory Keys.
Meanwhile, when Elina woke up, a stunned look appeared on her face.

Obviously, the dozens of dreams she had had with Chaos ended with her more frustrated than ever. Although it made her happy to see something outside of the slave mine, she always woke up having the memory of Chaos’s emotionless face.
However, she had just had a dream where Chaos gave her ass a gentle massage. Obviously, that is not something she saw coming.
It may be a dream, but to her, it is everything she could ever ask for. It is everything she wanted. As a slave, she is limited in what she can have.
So getting an ass massage from someone like Chaos is obviously shocking and a bit sensual.
That could be seen from the look of happiness on her face. She is happy, and the blush on her cheek says it all.

"H-He actually did that..." she muttered, rolling sideways on her bed. She had only been out for three hours, but despite the dream ending much faster than she expected, the ending was everything she could ask for.
Kent gave her something she could be happy about, and obviously, it worked like magic.
"Big sister, why is your cheek red?" Suddenly, a dirty little girl with rather beautiful, though disheveled, hair spoke, causing Elina to turn toward her.
"Flower, what are you doing up? Today is your day off, so go back to sleep," Elina said, her expression showing both concern and a bit of shyness.
It felt like she was caught red-handed doing something bad.
"I can’t sleep again. Big sister keeps giggling in her sleep," Flower said, sitting beside Elina’s makeshift bed.
"Why was big sister giggling?" she asked, with a cute, curious expression.
Elina smiled and answered, "Big sister just had a beautiful dream, so she is happy."
"Oh, I never dream of anything happy or beautiful. I want to dream like big sister."
Elina looked at the pained expression that appeared on Flower’s face, and her heart sank. This little girl is just 12 years old, but she has a slave collar around her neck.
She lost her parents a few days after she was born, so Elina basically raised her. Inside the mine, while there seems to be some form of cooperation among the slaves, everyone is for themselves.
Elina and Flower have their own thing going on. However, due to how fragile Flower is, she always adds some of her shift to hers so that the little girl would have some rest.
Elina is a Root Saint, so working a 12-hour shift with just 5 hours of break is normal for her. This had cut Flower’s shift from 7 hours a day to 2 hours.

But even so, whenever she returns from her shift, her entire body will be pained. Of course, she seems to always forget when she wakes up, but every time she sleeps, she seems to have some form of nightmare—sometimes waking up with tears in her eyes, sometimes even screaming.
So hearing her words touched Elina’s already broken heart. She pulled her in and hugged her, making sure her only friend in the mine is not alone.
"How about I tell you about my dream?" Elina said, and Flower nodded.
Since she can’t have her own dream, she might as well hear her big sister’s own. That would at least make her a bit happy and hopefully put her mind at rest.
"So in my dream, there is this handsome young man who is a dragon with horns and all..."
"Wow..." Flower was immediately hooked. This made Elina smile and continue her narration.
She has two more hours of rest before her shift, so there is plenty of time to make Chaos appear caring and loving in Flower’s mind.
They only have each other, so in times of need like this, making each other happy is the only way.

chapters.title: Chapter 1369: Memory Recap - Chaos
paragraphs: After analyzing the dream and making sense of what had happened, Kent decided to use the memory keys he had received so far.
He now has five each for Chaos, Jest, and Faceless, with two for the Ruthless Bandit.
Obviously, he would be reviewing the first three before diving into the life he had yet to know anything about.
He retrieved Chaos’s memory keys first. He would then go for Faceless’s memories next, the Jest. After that, the Ruthless Bandit’s memory would be reviewed.
The last time he recalled Chaos’s memories using the memory key, it ended with him entering seclusion, and Artemis choosing to protect him. That led to her death.
Kent had yet to see how Chaos reacted to that, since the memory ended before he came out of seclusion

So he wanted to know and perhaps be able to see more into how her death had impacted him. He already knew what would happen with Hera, so he wanted to see how the brute reacted when his stalker was killed.
Kent activated the first key, knowing the tower would do the rest. As expected, he entered a hibernative state the moment the memory key was activated.

This shows he is either seeing the memories in the 3rd person or has possessed Chaos’s body to experience them firsthand. Either way, he remained in that state for five days, the tower activating three more memory keys, leaving only one.
[Recap]
Inside those memories, after Artemis was killed, the attackers found Chaos’s body and killed him. However, Chaos wasn’t in his body when they destroyed it.
He was having an enlightenment, so his consciousness was out of his body. This saved his life because when he woke up, he merely underwent his 3rd Dragon Tribulation.
Whenever he undergoes dragon tribulation, he sheds his scales and builds new ones. Since he had no body during the tribulation, the moment he passed, he received a new body.
This helped him survive what could have been his death.
When he received the new body, he initially thought Artemis had killed him. Of course, he was angry because she was the one who knew where he had gone into seclusion.
However, soon, he found out what had truly happened.

He found out that while he was in seclusion, he was attacked, and Artemis died defending him. Chaos tried not to feel anything at first. He tried to convince himself that he was stronger than these small emotions.
However, as the days passed, whenever he stopped to think, the face of the annoying lady who kept following him wherever he went always appeared in his mind.
Eventually, the primitive human emotions Elina wanted him to feel began to affect him.
He would find himself missing her all of a sudden. Eventually, it got worse when he finally came to the realization that Artemis was the kind of person Elina wanted in his life.
She told him to surround himself with people who love him. Artemis was that kind of person. However, just like with Elina, everything was over before he could realise it.

So with his emotions shattering yet again, he did what he does best: he channeled his pain into revenge, and for a year, over 3,000 people died, many regretting ever pointing their weapons at Artemis.

His massacre grew even more ferocious, so many people chose to run despite never having any dispute with him. Chaos was so destructive that he had killed many simply because they were in some way affiliated with the people who killed Artemis.
But while avenging her, his conflict with the Forsaken race was also the headline of every major event.
A few years after killing the Forsaken kings and avenging Artemis, his major break came when he received intel from the same strange person.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
This intel pointed him to a small planet where the Forsaken race would be attacking next. Chaos got there before them, and when they came, none returned.
102,000 Forsaken beings died that day.
That massacre was one that finally sent a message to the Forsaken race, letting them know there was someone who wanted them dead.

And as expected of the Forsaken race, they sent everything after Chaos, hoping to kill him. Years passed, and while they came close to killing him many times, Chaos always found a way to survive every time, while taking thousands with him.

For 300 years, he had killed millions of forsaken beings and using their blood essence, he raised his strength to the point that even when he was at the Immortal King Stage, Immortal Lords were mere bugs before him.

He killed so much that, aside from the Forsaken race, the others started seeing him as a threat. In their eyes, someone like Chaos should be under heavy regulation. Allowing him to run around unchecked is too dangerous.
So they started coming after him, too. However, they soon realised the dragon was not someone they could easily provoke.
Of course, Chaos took no offense at their stupidity. However, he also didn’t allow them to mess with his vendetta.
Eventually, they started getting more aggressive, putting pressure on Chaos...

This caused him to start losing his hold on the Forsaken race to the point that one day, while he was trying to escape the assault of people he should have considered family and allies, an entire planet was destroyed by the Forsaken race.
That was when Chaos snapped and decided to turn his fury from the Forsaken race onto the Righteous Faction. However, this decision allowed the Forsaken race to plan well and ambush him.
The memory ended when Chaos was surrounded by 15 demigod Forsaken kings. He had just escaped the assault of the Righteous Faction when he was surrounded.
He knew the battle would be one he could not win. So from the start, he could only find a way to escape. The danger surrounding him is one he could never win.

"Reason why I hate those Righteous Factions, they use the pretense of wanting to make sure someone doesn’t become a threat later as an excuse to kill promising talents," Kent gritted his teeth, his aura rising.

He saw all the Righteous Faction had done, and while he would love nothing more than to kill every last one of them, he was also now aware of the danger involved, and as such, he wanted nothing more than to see Chaos survive and come for revenge.
This means he must use the last memory Key.
"Those hateful bastards. If they dare try that nonsense with me this time around, I will kill every last one of them and make sure their bodies are used to create more capable warriors."
Kent grabbed hold of the last memory key for Chaos and took a deep breath. He had just seen 380 years of Chaos’ life of pain and bloodshed.
Now, he wanted to see how he survived the ambush by 15 demigods while he was just an Immortal King.
He had no idea he would be ambushed, for he knew the location he was at wasn’t a place the Forsaken race would dare come.
However, they did, which now that he thinks about it sounds a bit fishy. So he wanted to find out more.
He pressed the memory key against his forehead, and his eyes rolled back...

chapters.title: Chapter 1370: Safira
paragraphs: "Why won’t this bastard dragon just die?" a demigod-level Forsaken king shouted, stabbing a large spear at Chaos’s bloody neck.

Just when the spear was about to touch his neck, golden pentagon scales appeared and blocked it. This gave Chaos the time to move back. However, he didn’t get far before a large boulder slammed hard into his back, sending him crashing to the ground.
Blood exploded out from his Dragon Maw, his wing breaking at a few joints.
"Damn it," his loud dragon voice filled the place as he used the void to move away just when a third demigod came with a powerful stab.
Chaos was locked down with no chance to even retaliate. All he could do was defend and look for a way to escape. However, after three hours, he found no path to take.
Being surrounded by 15 demigods isn’t something he could easily handle.
But while he was still alive, his entire body was littered with deep cuts. His bones were broken, and even his left eye had been blinded.
The only thing keeping him alive was his incredibly hard scales and unyielding will.
He was merely an Immortal King, but under the assault of 15 demigods, he was able to survive for three good hours. But it seemed he was running out of time.
"I guess there is no other way. I need to use it," Chaos said before transforming into his humanoid form.
"Chaos Heart."
He stabbed his claw into his chest and pulled out a golden orb. Then, without any hesitation, he channeled his energy into it.
"This is not over." After saying that, he clenched the golden orb, and it exploded, sending powerful shockwaves blasting the 15 demigods several kilometers back.

A portal formed before Chaos, and so, dragging his body, he jumped into it and vanished from sight. He had formed three Chaos Hearts, but to save himself, he exploded one, bringing his combat power down several degrees.
However, because he had to survive, he didn’t think about that. He could always reform the Chaos Heart and get his revenge. So survival was a must.
After he entered the portal, it closed, preventing the demigod-level Forsaken kings from following him. They had failed to kill the one person who posed a threat to their kind.
So they had to go back and report their failure.
Meanwhile, inside a valley of ice, a portal opened, and Chaos fell from it, landing on the crystal floor unconscious. He had lost consciousness the moment he jumped into the portal.
He was already on his last leg, and the pain from exploding his Chaos Heart also added to his becoming unconscious the moment he vanished from sight.

However, he had no idea he would be appearing in such a dangerous place. If he knew, he would have at least remained conscious long enough to find a good place to hide his body so as not to freeze to death.
The location where he appeared was extremely hazardous for non-ice users, so Chaos was still in danger eventhough he escaped from the demigods.
However, a few minutes after he appeared, a pale-looking lady appeared beside his body. She gave him a long and complicated look before waving her hand.
Chaos’s body vanished along with her. The next time they appeared, it was inside a cave where she seemed to have been living for a while now.
She set his body down, and after a few internal struggles, she cleaned his body and applied some medication before using her energy to heal him.
One could tell healing him was the last thing she wanted, but a part of her overcame that emotion, and she did what she had to.
After about a month, Chaos’s body was healed. The only thing left was for him to wake up. He would have to heal his own internal injuries when he woke up.

But as the days passed, the lady kept applying medication as if wanting him to wake up early. A year later, Chaos woke up. However, when he saw the face staring at him, his eyes narrowed, and his claws appeared, gleaming with a dangerous light.
"Relax, dragon. If I had wanted you dead, I would have long done it," she spoke in an indifferent tone before pointing toward the entrance.
"If you can walk, then please leave this place. I have already done enough damage to have you around for long."

Chaos stared at her for several minutes, his thoughts chaotic. He had no idea why a Forsaken being would save his life. That wasn’t just something he expected of her, so he was confused and a bit lost about what to even say.
In the end, he said what he could. "Thank you."
Chaos tried to stand up, but he couldn’t. So he chose to heal himself first. A couple of hours later, he could walk, so he stood up.
"My name is—"
"I know who you are, and I have no ambition in knowing you beyond your name, so just leave. The next time we meet, we will be enemies, so do well to remember that."

"Still, thank you for saving my life. I will repay you later." He looked at his finger and could still see his space ring. He reached into it and retrieved a crystal. He placed it down, then started walking out of the cave.
"Safira... My name is Safira, and I hope we never meet ever again."
"We will let destiny decide." Chaos left, and Kent woke up. At once, he entered another dragon enlightenment...
In a faraway place, a pale-looking lady with tattered clothes hid behind a tree, her breath coming in ragged.
In her hand was a markshift spear made from the bones of a beast. If this bone were to appear in the universe, many gods would fight over it.
Yet this lady held it like a weapon as she looked to her left. About 10,000 km away, a very large serpent with bright red scales kept searching for something.
If Universal gods were to meet this serpent, the first thing they would do is break into tears and perhaps try to run for their dear lives.
After about ten minutes, it hissed very loudly and slithered off.
HAAA

The lady exhaled, then she ran off too. Several hours later, she appeared in front of a cave. She stopped and surveyed the area first. After making sure there was no danger in sight, she entered the cave.
She sat down and leaned against the wall, her entire body aching like hell.

"I guess I was lucky this time around," she said, taking another deep sigh. "Ah, what the hell, it isn’t as if I can die anyway. But getting eaten alive also hurt like hell." She smiled weakly, then retrieved a crystal from her space ring.
Many years ago, the Primordial Chaos Dragon gave her that crystal. Several eras later, she still held on to it.
"A lot has happened after we met, Chaos. I hope you got what you wanted, for I had received the opposite of what I wanted."
She smiled again, then she exhaled.
"I will try again after another million years." She closed her eyes and started to recover her strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1371: Origin Law Diagram
paragraphs: Kent remained in his enlightened state for three full days.
He had already been through this process several times, so it wasn’t something new to him. This enlightened process had helped him awaken more of his bloodline and some Innate Aspects.
However, this time around, when he came out of the enlightenment, instead of his bloodline shooting past the 26%, something completely different happened.
The moment he opened his eyes, a powerful aura exploded out from his body, and his body was lifted into the air, instantly getting cocooned in a mix of red and golden scaly-looking shells.
This had never happened before.
So even Gaia, Akira, and Dori created clones and sent them to guard him. They wanted to see what would happen to him when he woke up.

Thankfully, they didn’t wait for long, since 20 days later, the cocoon cracked and soon came undone. From within, a handsome golden-haired dragon was revealed, causing Gaia and her sisters to turn and look at each other.
They weren’t concerned about the fact that Kent had become more handsome. Kent was already handsome, so adding more handsome to the bag was not something to be shocked by.
Their stunned looks came from the diagram hovering behind him. It seemed to be made of wood or some kind of metal with a golden-brownish color.
The design consisted of three overlapping circles, with an intersection at the center.
The three circles had different colors. One was red, the second was black, and the last was white. Just a simple glance is enough to tell it is something of higher importance.
"The Origin Law Diagram," the three cosmic lolis muttered at the same time, a look of excitement appearing on their tiny faces.
Before Kent could even examine how strong he had become, they grabbed him and dragged him to the side to have a better look.
"What is happening, ladies?" Kent asked, but they ignored him and continued searching and examining the three rings for a couple of minutes before turning to him.
"Congratulations, big brother."
"Thank you. But can we start by telling me what the hell I have awakened, considering you three seem even more pumped than I am."
"Big brother is not smiling now because he has yet to understand what he has awakened. But even if he were to see what the tower had to say, I am not sure Big Brother would understand it.

So we will take our time to explain it, and well, you do well to follow, because what is behind you is something that will one day make you the overlord of this universe. It is the answer to everything," Gaia said, then Dori took over.
"Before we talk about the diagram behind you, big brother should know that when it comes down to what makes a god a god, it all revolves around three things: Divinity, Domain, and Law.

These three things define a god and would one day make one a supreme. Regardless of what path one walked, the moment they reach the stage to become a god, the only thing they would need is these three things.
However, while many say divinity and domain are important, I say they are wrong. I say at the end of the day, the laws are what govern one’s journey to the peak.

We all came to the conclusion that Divinity grows when the god is a faith god. Their domain expands as the number of their worshippers increases. However, when it comes to the laws, it is all about comprehension/understanding."
Akira took over...

"Many years ago, before the universe nearly came to an end at the hands of the Void Beasts, there lived six beings known as True Primordials. They were being created by the universe with the intent of becoming its guardians.

However, when they arrived, they found something rather binding, something that made them come to the conclusion that when it comes to the source of all things, the laws of the universe cannot be done away with.
They found out that the laws of the universe came from somewhere, a place they called the Origin. It is the origin of all laws and their understanding.
They were beings created by the universe, so they were masters of all law.
However, from the day they discovered there is an Origin of all laws, they became obsessed.
So they decided to study it, and what they found made them give up everything to ensure we have this discussion today."
Gaia took over...
"The diagram behind you is the Origin Law Diagram. It is a creation directly from the origin law source, and contained within are the six seals of the Origin Law.
To better protect the universe, the six true primordials gave up everything to create this item, giving you a heads-up on what is coming and what must be done to prevent it.
Basically, this diagram contains six seals of Origin, seals that would one day open and allow you to touch the origin law of all things.
Basically, contained within this diagram is the secret of the universe."

"The origin law, huh..." A smile appeared on Kent’s face. When he met Axiom and his pals on the last floor of the Void Temple, they said Chaos was able to send them back in time because he had touched the origin law.𝗳𝚛𝚎𝚎𝘄𝕖𝕓𝕟𝕠𝚟𝚎𝕝.𝗰𝕠𝐦
Kent placed no emphasis on it before. However, now that he had heard what his three cosmic lolis said, he couldn’t help but wonder just what kind of treasure he had awakened this time around.
"Now that I think about it, did I use the origin law to call into space and time to call the 13 legions to my aid during the great war?"
Kent’s mind started to spin. He indeed had just learned something big, and that alone was enough to tell him what he needed to know.
"What about the seventh space at the center?" Kent asked. The three circles interconnecting had formed some intersections, with the middle one formed from all three circles.

"Big brother should know that the true primordials comprehended an aspect of the Origin Law, and so they sealed it inside the ring. Since Big Brother is also a True Primordial, he must comprehend his own origin law and seal it.
No one can use another’s Origin law comprehension. However, with the Origin Law Diagram, Big Brother can use the origin law of the previous true primordials."
"Amazing. I guess I have struck it big now," Kent laughed, feeling very happy.
"Big brother had indeed struck it big this time. The only thing is for Big Brother to become an immortal so he can start comprehending the laws.
The moment big brother gains absolute mastery of any law, he will start seeing the origin law. That would be when the Origin Law Diagram will come into play.
But even now, if the master were to study the energy patterns in the diagram, he would be able to learn something good from it."
Kent nodded and dismissed the diagram.
"Thanks, ladies. I will be sure to play with you all when I am done here."
Gaia and her sisters nodded and vanished. They hid some things because of karmic backlash. However, they trusted their big brother would be able to figure it out on his own.

But even if he were to see what the tower had to say, I am not sure Big Brother would understand it.
So we will take our time to explain it, and well, you do well to follow, because what is behind you is something that will one day make you the overlord of this universe.
It is the answer to everything," Gaia said, then Dori took over.
"Before we talk about the diagram behind you, big brother should know that when it comes down to what makes a god a god, it all revolves around three things: Divinity, Domain, and Law.
These three things define a god and would one day make one a supreme.
Regardless of what path one walked, the moment they reach the stage to become a god, the only thing they would need is these three things.
However, while many say divinity and domain are important, I say they are wrong.
I say at the end of the day, the laws are what govern one’s journey to the peak.
We all came to the conclusion that Divinity grows when the god is a faith god.
Their domain expands as the number of their worshippers increases.
However, when it comes to the laws, it is all about comprehension/understanding."
Akira took over...
"Many years ago, before the universe nearly came to an end at the hands of the Void Beasts, there lived six beings known as True Primordials.
They were being created by the universe with the intent of becoming its guardians.

However, when they arrived, they found something rather binding, something that made them come to the conclusion that when it comes to the source of all things, the laws of the universe cannot be done away with.
They found out that the laws of the universe came from somewhere, a place they called the Origin.
It is the origin of all laws and their understanding.
They were beings created by the universe, so they were masters of all law.
However, from the day they discovered there is an Origin of all laws, they became obsessed.
So they decided to study it, and what they found made them give up everything to ensure we have this discussion today."
Gaia took over...
"The diagram behind you is the Origin Law Diagram.
It is a creation directly from the origin law source, and contained within are the six seals of the Origin Law.
To better protect the universe, the six true primordials gave up everything to create this item, giving you a heads-up on what is coming and what must be done to prevent it.
Basically, this diagram contains six seals of Origin, seals that would one day open and allow you to touch the origin law of all things.
Basically, contained within this diagram is the secret of the universe."
"The origin law, huh..." A smile appeared on Kent’s face.
When he met Axiom and his pals on the last floor of the Void Temple, they said Chaos was able to send them back in time because he had touched the origin law.𝗳𝚛𝚎𝚎𝘄𝕖𝕓𝕟𝕠𝚟𝚎𝕝.𝗰𝕠𝐦
Kent placed no emphasis on it before.
However, now that he had heard what his three cosmic lolis said, he couldn’t help but wonder just what kind of treasure he had awakened this time around.
"Now that I think about it, did I use the origin law to call into space and time to call the 13 legions to my aid during the great war?"
Kent’s mind started to spin.
He indeed had just learned something big, and that alone was enough to tell him what he needed to know.
"What about the seventh space at the center?" Kent asked.
The three circles interconnecting had formed some intersections, with the middle one formed from all three circles.
"Big brother should know that the true primordials comprehended an aspect of the Origin Law, and so they sealed it inside the ring.
Since Big Brother is also a True Primordial, he must comprehend his own origin law and seal it.
No one can use another’s Origin law comprehension.
However, with the Origin Law Diagram, Big Brother can use the origin law of the previous true primordials."
"Amazing.
I guess I have struck it big now," Kent laughed, feeling very happy.
"Big brother had indeed struck it big this time.
The only thing is for Big Brother to become an immortal so he can start comprehending the laws.
The moment big brother gains absolute mastery of any law, he will start seeing the origin law.
That would be when the Origin Law Diagram will come into play.
But even now, if the master were to study the energy patterns in the diagram, he would be able to learn something good from it."
Kent nodded and dismissed the diagram.
"Thanks, ladies.
I will be sure to play with you all when I am done here."
Gaia and her sisters nodded and vanished.
They hid some things because of karmic backlash.
However, they trusted their big brother would be able to figure it out on his own.

chapters.title: Chapter 1372: Memory Recap - Faceless
paragraphs: After the excitement died down, Kent took a deep breath and decided to move on to the next memory key. He had just learned that the treasure he awakened contains six origin laws.
That was something to be thrilled about.
So he had to let his mind rest and think about it. There is an alot to take in, but for now he planned to calm his mind.
Once he managed to settle his thoughts on what to do, he decided to handle what came next.
He would soon be heading into unknown territory, so the earlier he learned more about his abilities and life, the better.
"This is awesome, then. I will make sure that the moment things cool down a bit, I will dive back in and see if I can find more clues."
The issue with Safira, now that he had remembered, also seemed to affect him somehow. To this day, he had no idea why she saved him.

She was supposed to kill him, but she saved him instead, and that just wasn’t something he could wrap his mind around. However, now, he would have to wait and see if he could do something to help her.
Gaia already had a solution, but he would see if there was a better solution than going to that bitch for help.
After taking a few breaths, Kent activated the first of the five memory keys and entered the sleep-like state yet again.
The last time, he remembered up to the point where he made the seven assassins his first Faceless Agents.
Their objective was to help him protect the innocent from the shadows.
That was the day he created the Faceless Agent, and also the day things changed for him.
That was because on that day, he received a contract to kill someone he later learned was a Forsaken Seer.
He had yet to leave for that mission, but he conducted some background checks and found out he was about to go on the next most dangerous mission.
However, he was excited about it, so he became very committed.
Now that he had five more chances to see what happened next, he was both excited to see what more of his knowledge of the Faceless Assassin would expand into after these memories were recovered.
[Recap]
The memory started when Faceless was ready to leave.
After bringing his seven Faceless Agents to his home planet, Bayla, he created the first Midnight Temple and left them some powerful assassin techniques before leaving.
He had many missions for them, so he made sure they understood what would happen next and were ready to face it.
After he left, he went to a planet far from Planet Bayla to see an old friend. This friend was like his personal internet.
He knew something about everything.
So he used his expertise to gather more information on the Forsaken Seer. Once that was handled, he left and slowly started working his way toward his goal.

With the Faceless Art, he kept stealing faces and making his way closer to the Forsaken Seer. Just like when he killed the Demon King, he took his time to examine the Forsaken Seer and know who to kill to be able to take one step closer to her.
Already, Faceless was only a True Immortal and a Shadow Immortal, just a couple of steps away from becoming a Shadow God.
His expertise in assassination was already stronger than his cultivation realm.
However, he was going after a Forsaken Seer whose expertise was anticipating danger and making sure she weaved a complex solution, one that couldn’t easily be seen through.
That alone proved she is a dangerous opponent.

However, Faceless was no simple assassin. He was someone who had mastered the art of patience, so even after 100 years, when he was nowhere close to killing the Forsaken Seer, he didn’t grow impatient.
He had already seen enough and was making sure he left no stone unturned.
One hundred and thirty years later, after he embarked on this mission, his big break came when he learned a planet had been taken over by the Forsaken race.
Although many had died, he knew that if the Forsaken Seer lived for another year, she would help the Forsaken race expand. So, against all odds, he decided to steal his first Forsaken face.
For reasons unknown to him, the idea of stealing a Forsaken face was a terrible one. But he knew the mission came first, so he did, and that was when everything changed.
He proceeded quickly, getting much closer to the Forsaken Seer by stealing more Forsaken faces.
The day he killed her, he learned the Forsaken Seer was into women, so to get close to her, he had to kill the lady she was supposed to meet that evening.
And while he had done so many times, turning into a female Forsaken being was Faceless’s first time.
But to kill a threat, he swallowed his pride and did what had to be done.
That night, he helped the Forsaken Seer take her clothes off and even helped her bathe. However, she never came out of the bathroom.
That was because Faceless had long poisoned the room and the air, so all he had to do was be a bit caring and take her mind off the idea that someone would try to kill her.
Inside the bathroom, the poison kicked in, and that was how she died.
But after she died, Faceless didn’t escape.
He had completed his mission, but he decided to take on one more: killing all the Forsaken beings.
It was a long night, but when day broke, 120,000 Forsaken beings died, their blood creating a river on the planet that was supposed to be their new home.
Faceless was rather thorough. He made sure that every last person he killed had their memories scanned.
So after that fateful mission, he learned that to save all lives, he and the Midnight Shadows must make sure the Forsaken race doesn’t escape their imprisonment.
And thus, he decided to expand the Midnight Shadows. So he added seven more assassins and made them Faceless Agents.
What followed was 6,000 years of memory, during which he trained and went on missions to kill Forsaken beings. For 6,000 years, Faceless made sure his influence was felt.
He made sure the Forsaken race became aware of what the heavens had in store for them.
In the end, Faceless finally became a demigod. And to become a god, he had to leave yet again and embark on another mission; this time, there was a chance he would never return.

That was because, on the day he became a demigod, he met a woman who seemed to have a grudge against him. He had no idea why she knew him personally. After all, he was using a different face to make sure nobody recognized him.
But she did, and after she was killed by him, he found out she had cursed him.
From the onset, he could already sense that the curse would only grow stronger as he, too, became stronger. So he decided to complete one last mission and hopefully find a way to break the curse.

But before he left, he created a way for future Midnight Shadows to join, and even future Faceless Agents. After making sure all this was handled, he left, and that was the last time any of the Faceless Agents heard from him.
Years later, when the universe was threatened by creatures from the Shadows, the Faceless Assassin would appear again, this time to end what he started.

chapters.title: Chapter 1373: Irregular Pattern
paragraphs: Kent took a deep breath, his expression softening a bit. He had just seen more of another life he had lived, and it was thrilling like he expected.
"So that was how I met Hera, huh."
From the memories he had seen so far, this was the first time he had encountered Hera’s incarnation. He knew she had followed him throughout the many lives he had lived.
They first met during the Primordial Era, but like Vexthra said, as his heart demon, she had followed him all the way to this life too, and that was just too much to take in.

The Hera he met during the Shadow Era was an army general of the demon king he had killed before. It turned out that when he killed the demon king, a general under his command was away on a mission that day.
That general was Hera’s incarnation.
So when she returned and learned what had happened, she decided to come after him.
Of course, what made Faceless a bit restless was the fact that Hera was able to notice him back then, despite the fact that not even his Faceless Agents knew what he looked like.

There was absolutely no way she would have known what he looked like before even coming after him. So the fact that she did tell him the curse she placed on him during the Primordial Era was way stronger than he thought.
"But where could she have gotten such a curse from?" Kent wondered, his gaze narrowing. "There is no way such a curse could come from a nobody like her. There is more to this than I know."
Kent took a deep breath and let his emotions settle down. He had not even once considered the fact that maybe he was being conspired against, even when his heart demon awakened during the Shadow Era.
But now that he thought about it, some things didn’t seem to make sense.
"Maybe I am overthinking things, but I think something smells fishy. I’d better be careful and find a way to break this curse soon before it becomes a problem."

He had seen his memories to the point when Faceless entered the Shadow Realm to cultivate and become a god. He didn’t know what awaited him there, but the fact that he told his Faceless Agents there was a chance he might not return alive proved that where he was going was dangerous.
"I will know more when I get more memory keys."
[The master should know that from here onwards, he would only receive memory diaries for the Faceless Assassin.]
Kent nodded. He had already been through the various stages of recovering his memories. One such method was memory diaries, in which memories were written as diary entries.

Whenever he was done reading such a diary, he felt like he had been there when it happened. So, regardless of what method he used to receive his memories next time, he would still learn what happened in the Shadow Realm and how it shaped him to become someone worthy of leading the Shadow Era.

Many battles were fought on grand scales; however, the Shadow War was fought in the shadows. It was brutal, chilling, and very silent. So he wanted to witness how he faced that era and how he liberated it.
"I will soon reunite with the Faceless Agents and find out more from them. A lot had happened, so I’d better be ready to face whatever danger this era has in store for me."
After spending a couple of minutes learning more about his life as the Faceless Assassin, he stopped and decided to focus on Lord Genesis’s life.

The last time he recalled that life, he was about to challenge the 4th level of the sword bridge. He had already passed the first three levels, making him an Inner disciple of the Whispering Wind Sword Sect.

Although he was merely a Sword King with the cultivation base of an Empyrean, someone like him was meant to be in the outer region. However, he had defeated a Sword King and two Sword Emperors, which was enough reason to become an Inner disciple.
His aim was to pass the 4th level and go to the 5th. He wanted to see just how powerful Sword Divines were, so he planned to defeat the Sword Emperor on the 4th floor.
"Ten-Star Sword God...wait for me." Kent smiled and activated the memory key.

The next second, he was back on the 4th level of the pagoda, now possessing Jest’s body. However, unlike the dream where he could control Chaos’s body, this time he had no control over anything. However, he could feel everything Jest was feeling.
The Ten-Star Sword God locked gazes with Jest, his ten swords spinning in the air. "If you can last five minutes, it will be your win."
"If you say so," Jest smiled, and then he activated the Broken Sword Realm he had copied from Adraian. At one time, the entire half of his space was filled with thousands of broken swords.
The Ten-Star Sword God smiled and gestured forward; three swords from the ten moved forward and arrived before Jest before he could even move.
However, drawing on his extensive understanding of swordsmanship, he raised his sword and blocked one of the swords, the pressure of the attack pushing him back.

Just then, two of the swords moved behind him, aiming to stab him from the back. However, the Broken Sword Realm wasn’t for decoration. Two broken swords moved and collided with the other two swords, deflecting them back.

The Ten-Star Sword God raised an eyebrow, clearly intrigued by the deflection. It took a deep understanding of swordsmanship and heightened perception to defend against the two swords.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂
Without a word, he flicked his wrist, and the remaining seven swords joined the assault in perfect sync.
They formed a swirling vortex of steel, each blade humming with condensed sword intent, pressing down on Kent with deadly sharpness.
Jest’s expression remained calm, his senses sharp and focused.

He took a single step forward, his own sword trembling slightly in his grip—not from fear, but from the sheer volume of energy surging through it. Jest is merely a Sword King with level 5 Heavenly Sword Intent and aura.
That much power was now being channeled through his sword, causing it to vibrate like hell.

The Broken Sword Realm expanded further, the thousands of broken blades vibrating in response to his will. Jest’s mind is connected to all the swords in the domain, so with a thought, he can move just about any sword he wants.
They did not form neat patterns or elegant formations; instead, they created a chaotic storm of jagged edges, each fragment seemingly moving with independent malice.
It was like he didn’t want to let the Ten-Star Sword God know his next move. In swordsmanship, it is called an irregular pattern.
"Every sword has a pattern. They move in sequences and in a preplanned path. However, what if you have mastered sword patterns to the point you can create an irregular pattern?"
Jest smirked, then he pointed up. "I hope you learn something from this sword god." He moved, and the swords moved, their patterns jagged and all over the place.

chapters.title: Chapter 1374: Beautiful Swordsmanship
paragraphs: The Ten-Star Sword God only wanted Jest to last for five minutes. However, the moment he activated the Irregular pattern, everything changed.
In that moment, Jest went from a sword King to a sword prodigy that only appears once in an era. His image in his mind had shot up several degrees.
"Kid, where did you learn that?" the Ten-Star Sword God asked, his expression filled with shock. He may be the remnant soul of a sword god, but what he was seeing was just out of this world.
"I happen to know a lot about sword movement. The rest was just me making sure every movement of a sword—every last pattern—is memorized, then flipped and mixed up in a complex sequence.
Basically, I picked what you know and turned it upside down. But aside from doing that, I went ahead to twist it into a form that even if you see it, you wouldn’t know it."
Be it the Ten-Star Sword God or the others watching the battle, hearing what Jest had accomplished, they knew it wasn’t something someone of his standing should know.

The kind of thinking that goes into mastering those sword moves is just not something someone at his level can do. Many sword legends came before him, but none can say they have mastered all sword moves.
So the idea that Jest knows all sword moves is just not possible.
But the fact that he is going strong without missing even a single sword from the Ten-Star Sword God shows there is more to him than they all seem to see in him.

Three of the Ten-Star Sword God’s blades slashed in from the left in a blinding arc. Jest twisted his body at an impossible angle, his sword meeting the lead blade in a collision that sent sparks cascading like fireworks.
"Awesome," many disciples muttered in unison.
At the same moment, four broken swords shot upward from the ground beneath him, intercepting the other two attackers and forcing them to veer off course.
The Ten-Star Sword God let out a low chuckle. "Not bad. You indeed have some potential, kid, but can you really win against a sword Emperor of my caliber?"
He clapped his hands once.

The ten swords suddenly froze in midair, then realigned into the shape of a massive, radiant sword formation—a perfect ten-pointed star that pulsed with blinding golden light. His sword intent was being harnessed to the maximum.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
The pressure increased tenfold; even the air itself seemed to solidify around Jest.
Jest gritted his teeth.
Blood began to trickle from the corner of his mouth as the oppressive sword bore into his body. The load bearing down on him was just too much for him to remain standing, but he remained standing.
His eyes burned brighter, determination oozing from them. He raised his free hand, palm outward, and whispered, "Shatter."
He clenched his fist.
Every single broken sword in the realm answered at once.
They detonated outward in a deafening explosion, sending thousands of fragments flying.
The fragments turned into deadly shrapnel, hurtling toward the Ten-Star Sword God from every conceivable direction.
The golden star formation flickered under the onslaught; several of its points cracked and dimmed as the broken blades did what they were commanded to do.
The Ten-Star Sword God narrowed his eyes.
On the first floor, Adrian, whose sword realm Jest had copied, also narrowed his eyes. "I didn’t know you could do that."
Even he, the owner, didn’t know he could further break his broken swords into fragments to land an attack like that. If he had known, perhaps he would have used it against Jest.
"What a monster," he smiled and continued to watch.
Inside the cave, the green-haired lady also kept a close eye on the battle, just like every last disciple and elder who was watching with an unblinking expression.

"Just who are you?" she muttered, her expression turning a bit dark. She suspected Jest had somehow managed to learn her sword realm after he clashed with one of her Nine Emotions Sword Realms, Seraphina.
Initially, it was merely a suspicion, but after seeing what Jest had done with Adrian’s sword realm, she was inclined to believe he had copied it.
Naturally, if he had indeed copied it, then he must die, for she could not have someone running with a loophole into her sword realm.

However, now that she was seeing what Jest was capable of, she couldn’t help but see him as an asset. This put her in a complicated situation, but the more she saw him fight the Ten-Star Sword God, the more her interest in him grew.
After four minutes, the Ten-Star Sword God finally saw that he would lose the battle. But even with this discovery, he didn’t seem to care about it.
"It would be best if you use your sword realm," Jest said with a smug smile. Blood trickled down the corner of his mouth. The pressure he was under was just too much for him to handle.

This was a battle between swordsmen, so all other treasures and skills he knew were useless. However, even though they could work and give him an edge, after four minutes of battling the Ten-Star Sword God, he realised he was no match for him.
Surviving 5 minutes is fine, but he cannot defeat him.
But he also didn’t want to lose without seeing his sword realm.
"Are you sure you want to see it?" the Ten-Star Sword God asked, a smile playing on his handsome demon face.
"But of course. You have 30 seconds, which means it is my win. But I cannot head to the fifth level without seeing your sword realm."
"The moment I activate my sword realm, you will lose, so let’s wait out the thirty seconds so you can pass. You have already proven yourself to me and everyone."
Jest had no objections, and frankly, nobody who watched the four minutes of beautiful swordsmanship would have any objections. Jest had proven himself, and all could see that.

So, allowing him to pass was just something none of them minded. They all thought he wouldn’t even be able to pass the first level. However, he was now on the fourth level, and that was just something none of them saw coming.
"There is something I want to know," the Ten-Star Sword God said. Then he asked, "When you are there, there are 1.6 million sword moves out there. Were you joking, or is that the truth?"
"It is the truth. Before coming here, I had the privilege to meet someone whose understanding of the sword is just beyond any man’s or god’s understanding.
He confirmed that there are indeed 1.6 million moves, and I have mastered all of them. My mission is to rise to the peak and pave the way for all who have been stuck at the last stage."
The Ten-Star Sword God narrowed his eyes and asked with a small smile, "You want to become a Sword Celestial?"
"That is my main goal, yes."
"Does that mean you are walking your own path?" This question, however, drew everyone’s attention, for they all wanted to know just what the hell was going on with Jest.
No sword king should be that monstrous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1375: Sword Genius
paragraphs: The question hung in the air for a few minutes before Jest nodded in response.
"Indeed. Since there are no paths leading to the peak, I decided to create my own."
His answer stunned everyone, leaving many wondering if they had heard right. What Jest had just said is basically impossible.
It was said that during the primordial Era, many powerful swordsmen rose to prominence. However, the highest they could go was the Sword Supreme stage.
This was due to so many factors.
One of said factors is their inability to comprehend the Dao of the sword in their own understanding.
To take the final step, one must become one with the sword. There are many factors that go into becoming one with the sword. However, the main thing is the ability to comprehend the Dao of the sword.

By walking an already threaded path, it becomes impossible to reach that stage. Of course, they also said that at the peak, one can go around this process by making the path their own. However, nobody since the primordial Era had been able to achieve that.
So in that context, one can walk the path others had already threaded, and then when they get to the sword supreme stage, they find ways to make it their own.
However, many had tried and proven to be false, so that idea was scrapped.
There are other theories that there are many other ways to the peak. However, in the end, following an already threaded path can take one as far as the Sword Supreme stage.
Many years ago, everyone came to that conclusion.
However, what if one is to walk their own path? What if the path never threaded is the path to the peak? What if, against all odds, one can only believe in themselves and do it?
Many tried, and the highest they ever reached was the Sword Saint stage. Many tried to walk their own path, but they couldn’t even get past the Sword Saint stage.
But here is Jest, walking his own path, and he had already reached the Sword King stage.
That is a universe-altering reveal, and its impact could already be felt within the sect.
"You are kidding, right?" the Ten-Star Sword God asked, his gaze narrowing.

"I don’t believe I will joke about something like this. I am indeed walking my own path. It took me a couple of years, but I have made some progress, and I believe after today, I will make more progress."
"May I ask how long you have been walking your own path?"
"Considering I had been imprisoned for years and chased around by a crazy bitch for a couple more years, I say this is roughly 400 years since I started walking my own path."
"And you are already a Sword King?" The Ten-Star Sword God’s eyes widened, and so did everyone’s.

Jest laughed and said, "The plan is to make sure at the end of the day, I make it to the peak, so wasting time is not an option. It was also why I ascended from the mortal realm to the immortal realm. I came to make sure I meet people like you who would enlighten me.
There is a chance I might fail. But there is a big chance I will succeed. If I did, then there is a high chance more swordsmen would follow, because my reaching the peak is a good thing.
I can share my knowledge with the rest of the universe, and perhaps many would be able to reach my level one day."

The Ten-Star Sword God smiled. "You sure know how to talk big, Kid. Do you know how many great swordsmen have tried, but failed? Also, do you really think reaching the peak is a joke... talk about sharing knowledge."
Jest shook his head. "A swordsman who doesn’t share knowledge, in my eyes, is a selfish person. Adrian allowed me to learn his sword realm, knowing full well I could easily use it against him.
However, he allowed me to learn because he has integrity as a swordsman. So if one day I were to make it to the peak, allowing others to know the way is something I shouldn’t be forced to even do.
I am learning from others, so others should also learn from me."

The Ten-Star Sword God stood there for a full five minutes, his mind spinning. He may be just a remnant of his glorious self, but what Jest had said struck a chord in his heart, making him think of many things.

Outside the Sword Bridge, the disciples and the elders of the sect were all thinking of what Jest had said. They all knew how hard it was to even walk an already-threaded path. So if what Jest was saying is true, then someone like him should be treasured and protected.
There was so much left to learn, and if a brave kid like him had such a mindset, then there was no telling just what he would be able to accomplish in the future.
"You know, many would not take you seriously if they learn you are walking your own path. However, to think you have already become a Sword King, I am inclined to believe you have some talent in you.
So I will make you a deal."
Jest nodded. "I am listening."

"I will teach you my sword realm, or more like display it for as many times as you want, until you can comprehend it. One day, if you reach the peak, I want you to become my master and teach me the way, too.
I know you want to share the knowledge with everyone. But being the disciple of the first Sword Celestial ever is different from hearing what he has to say to everyone.
So do we have a deal?"
"Of course. And to make it so, you know I wouldn’t go back on my words, I swear on the Sword Dao that if I go back on my words after I reach the peak, may my sword heart be destroyed."
The Ten-Star Sword God smiled, already gambling on something he knew could be his downfall. Jest would know all about his sword realm, as he did with Adrian and the other levels he challenged.

To create his own sword realm, he must first learn from others. It wouldn’t be like copying them. To him, it was more like understanding the various natures of swordsmanship and creating something new from them.
So if he were to learn from the Ten-Star Sword God, then there was a chance he would be getting closer to forming his own sword realm. The moment he did, he would become a Sword Emperor.

"Not many are brave like you, kid. I chose to walk a primitive path because I was afraid of failing. I had the chance to start over and walk my own path, but I didn’t. So don’t be like me or anyone else.
Be yourself, and one day, when you reach the peak, maybe you can inspire all of us to strive for success. We should strive for the absolute peak too."
"Thanks for the advice, senior."
"You can just call me Colins. I will be looking forward to the day you become a Sword God. Maybe then, you can fight me on equal footing."
"I look forward to that day too."
"Good. Now, be ready, I will start demonstrating my sword realm. Be sure to appreciate its beauty and strength."
Jest smiled and nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1376: Sword Sea Realm
paragraphs: Colins had already warned Jest that if he were to use his sword realm during their battle, he would be drowned in the chaos.
He actually meant that in the literal sense.
"Damn."
Jest muttered, his expression contorted in shock. There is just no way he could have seen something so unfathomable yet beautiful come from a swordsman.
Surging behind Colins is a sea of swords, so chaotic and beautiful that one wouldn’t even be able to decide whether they should run away or toward it.

"How does this make any sense? There is just no way anyone can survive this," Jest muttered, finally realizing he had underestimated Sword Emperors. He had been too arrogant in thinking that learning a few sword realms made him undisputed.

However, what he is seeing now is just out of this world. It is like he was seeing the end of him, but strangely, considering how beautiful the sword sea was, he just couldn’t help hoping it came quickly enough.
"My sword realm is called Sword Sea. It is not sea in the literal sense, just that my sword intent and aura had condensed so much sword that they appeared like water.

I can transform it at will; however, it takes so much practice and even energy to do that. So in situations like this, I merely drown the opponent, leaving their breath and body to the agonizing sharpness of the sword sea."
"Damn. How does one go about comprehending such a sword realm?"

Colins smiled and replied, "It took me 7,000 years to comprehend it. This is the initial form of my sword realm. I am sure by now, after it had become a sword domain since I am a Sword God, it would have already undergone so many changes."
"That is awesome," Jest said before sitting in a lotus posture.
"I will keep moving it, deactivating and reactivating it till you can comprehend it."
Jest nodded and started watching as the sword sea was moved around, transformed, and deactivated, only to be reactivated over and over again.
Minutes went by, but Jest remained seated, his expression calm, gaze fixed on the sword sea. Soon, an hour went by, but he was still seated.
"Do you think he can comprehend it?" a disciple asked his friend, since they all could see what Jest was doing.
"There is no telling if he can do it, but the fact that he has already comprehended two sword realms, I believe he can do this, too. Though I wonder if he would be able to use it."
"This is the sword realm of a Sword Emperor. If anything, that alone is to show you that comprehending it and using it are two different things."
"The kid has already done the impossible many times already, so there is no need to even think about whether he can use it. I say comprehending it is the most important thing here."
"What a monster."

Two hours passed in the blink of an eye, yet Jest remained seated, his expression calm. He was already focused to the point that even if he was attacked from behind, he wouldn’t be able to do anything.
Two and a half hours later, Jest smiled, then rose to his feet. He stretched his arm for a few seconds before turning to Colins.
"You can deactivate it now. I have already comprehended it."
Colins looked at him for a few seconds before doing as he was told. "Can I see it?" he asked.
"Of course." Jest raised his sword, and then, as if a dam broke open, a sea of swords appeared behind him, surging so violently that it rose several kilometers high into the air.
Colin could only stare at Jest in shock. It took him thousands of years to comprehend it, yet he did it in only two and a half hours.
That is next-level genius.
"Maybe you indeed have the makings of a Sword Celestial." He smiled, then waved his hand, opening a portal to the fifth level.
"Thank you for allowing me to comprehend your sword realm. It is very complex and full of potential. I will be sure to make good use of it."
"The dream is one day to reach the peak like you, so I guess I went all out, and it paid off quite well."
"That it did, and for one, I am impressed by what I have learned. I promise to learn from it, and one day when we meet, we will have a good battle."
"I look forward to that day also."
Jest had now passed the fourth floor, and so he had to advance to the fifth floor. But before that, there was something he wanted to know.
"I have a question, if you don’t mind."
"Go ahead and ask."
"How vast is the gap between a Sword Emperor and a Sword Divine?" Since he would be facing a Sword Divine next, he planned on learning something about them.
"All I can say is that from the Sword King to the Sword Monarch stage, it all has to do with one’s understanding of their sword realm.
At the Sword King stage, we comprehend our sword realm. Then, at the Sword Emperor stage, we focus on what we mostly call conceptualization.
It has something to do with improving our understanding of our sword realm through battles and of our sword intent while shaping the sword realm into a better state.
However, when we move to the Sword Divine stage, that is where we awaken the next level of sword energy called Divine.
This transforms our sword realm into a divine sword realm, just a few steps away from becoming a sword domain.
The next stages are, of course, the Sword Legend and finally Sword Immortal, where the final stages of becoming a sword god start.
However, between the Sword King and Sword Divine stages, know that it is all about one’s understanding of their sword realm and the divine sword energy."
Jest stood confused, but a part of him also had gained some understanding. "So in simple terms, a Sword King can fight a Sword Emperor because we both use Heavenly Sword Aura.
However, the moment we move to the Sword Divine stage, not even a Sword Emperor with level nine heavenly sword energy can contend with them."
"That about sums everything up."
"Damn."
Colin smiled, a bit amused by the look on Jest’s face. If forming his sword realm was already demanding, then how hard would it be when it came to advancing it?

"A word of advice, though: don’t expect so much from the fifth floor. The swordsman there is a powerful Sword Divine with level three Divine Sword Energy (Aura and Intent), so if you manage to defend against even a single sword strike from him, call yourself a genius among geniuses."
"That serious, huh?" Jest smiled. He had already seen what Colin was capable of, so he knew challenging a Sword Divine was just asking for too much.
If Colin had used his sword realm, even with the Broken Sword Realm and the Light Swords Realm at his disposal, it wouldn’t have been enough to survive even a single attack from him.
So, facing a Sword Divine was just out of his league.
"Once again, thank you for letting me comprehend your sword realm. I will repay you in the future when we meet."
Jest bowed, and then he entered the portal. When he appeared on the fifth floor, his eyes widened, a terrible wave of incinerating heat assaulting his body in that instant.

He actually meant that in the literal sense.
"Damn."
Jest muttered, his expression contorted in shock.
There is just no way he could have seen something so unfathomable yet beautiful come from a swordsman.
Surging behind Colins is a sea of swords, so chaotic and beautiful that one wouldn’t even be able to decide whether they should run away or toward it.
"How does this make any sense?
There is just no way anyone can survive this," Jest muttered, finally realizing he had underestimated Sword Emperors.
He had been too arrogant in thinking that learning a few sword realms made him undisputed.
However, what he is seeing now is just out of this world.
It is like he was seeing the end of him, but strangely, considering how beautiful the sword sea was, he just couldn’t help hoping it came quickly enough.
"My sword realm is called Sword Sea.
It is not sea in the literal sense, just that my sword intent and aura had condensed so much sword that they appeared like water.
I can transform it at will; however, it takes so much practice and even energy to do that.
So in situations like this, I merely drown the opponent, leaving their breath and body to the agonizing sharpness of the sword sea."
"Damn.
How does one go about comprehending such a sword realm?"
Colins smiled and replied, "It took me 7,000 years to comprehend it.
This is the initial form of my sword realm.
I am sure by now, after it had become a sword domain since I am a Sword God, it would have already undergone so many changes."
"That is awesome," Jest said before sitting in a lotus posture.
"I will keep moving it, deactivating and reactivating it till you can comprehend it."
Jest nodded and started watching as the sword sea was moved around, transformed, and deactivated, only to be reactivated over and over again.
Minutes went by, but Jest remained seated, his expression calm, gaze fixed on the sword sea.
Soon, an hour went by, but he was still seated.
"Do you think he can comprehend it?" a disciple asked his friend, since they all could see what Jest was doing.
"There is no telling if he can do it, but the fact that he has already comprehended two sword realms, I believe he can do this, too.
Though I wonder if he would be able to use it."
"This is the sword realm of a Sword Emperor.
If anything, that alone is to show you that comprehending it and using it are two different things."
"The kid has already done the impossible many times already, so there is no need to even think about whether he can use it.
I say comprehending it is the most important thing here."
"What a monster."
Two hours passed in the blink of an eye, yet Jest remained seated, his expression calm.
He was already focused to the point that even if he was attacked from behind, he wouldn’t be able to do anything.
Two and a half hours later, Jest smiled, then rose to his feet.
He stretched his arm for a few seconds before turning to Colins.
"You can deactivate it now.
I have already comprehended it."
Colins looked at him for a few seconds before doing as he was told.
"Can I see it?" he asked.
"Of course." Jest raised his sword, and then, as if a dam broke open, a sea of swords appeared behind him, surging so violently that it rose several kilometers high into the air.
Colin could only stare at Jest in shock.
It took him thousands of years to comprehend it, yet he did it in only two and a half hours.
That is next-level genius.
"Maybe you indeed have the makings of a Sword Celestial." He smiled, then waved his hand, opening a portal to the fifth level.
"Thank you for allowing me to comprehend your sword realm.
It is very complex and full of potential.
I will be sure to make good use of it."
"The dream is one day to reach the peak like you, so I guess I went all out, and it paid off quite well."
"That it did, and for one, I am impressed by what I have learned.
I promise to learn from it, and one day when we meet, we will have a good battle."
"I look forward to that day also."

But before that, there was something he wanted to know.
"I have a question, if you don’t mind."
"Go ahead and ask."
"How vast is the gap between a Sword Emperor and a Sword Divine?" Since he would be facing a Sword Divine next, he planned on learning something about them.
"All I can say is that from the Sword King to the Sword Monarch stage, it all has to do with one’s understanding of their sword realm.
At the Sword King stage, we comprehend our sword realm.
Then, at the Sword Emperor stage, we focus on what we mostly call conceptualization.
It has something to do with improving our understanding of our sword realm through battles and of our sword intent while shaping the sword realm into a better state.
However, when we move to the Sword Divine stage, that is where we awaken the next level of sword energy called Divine.
This transforms our sword realm into a divine sword realm, just a few steps away from becoming a sword domain.
