chapters.title: Chapter 1397: First Death Note Mission
paragraphs: [Planet Offin - Immortal World]

Planet Offin is a low-tier Immortal world. As a low-tier Immortal world, the strongest being that can be found there is merely an Immortal Lord. While formidable in a way, considering they are immortal Lords, people on this planet see them as gods.
Medium-tier Immortal worlds have multiple Immortal Lords, with high-tier Immortal worlds having even demigods as the patriarchs and matriarchs.
As for Supreme-tier Immortal worlds like Planet Gemini, demigods aren’t even the leaders of the families there.
So, a low-tier Immortal world had no standing when all things are put into consideration.
On Planet Offin, there are three ruling families. There is the Tate family, ruled by the Red Fox King. They are a race of red foxes, a rare breed of foxes, just like the sky foxes.

There is the Raden family, ruled by the Storm Immortal. They are a race of Storm Humans, beings born with a natural affinity for water. Their affinity allows them to manipulate water in various forms.
The last is the Adin family, ruled by the Dark King. They are Dark Elves and the most vile race on that planet.
They are also the strongest, considering even the youngest heir is a True Immortal and the scum that had been plaguing the red foxes and Storm Humans for hundreds of years now.
"Young master, the fresh batch of slaves is in," a young dark elf spoke from behind a door. Inside the room, a lean dark elf sat on the bed, three red foxes working on his little prince.
Hearing his subordinate’s words, a smile appeared on his face. He pushed aside the three red foxes and put on his clothes, rushing out of the room with a beaming smile on his face.
"Take me to them."
He and his subordinate took to the sky and vanished from sight. A few minutes later, they arrived in a small clearing where the rest of it was a vast forest.
Lined up and in chains were over 200 red foxes and Storm Humans. Looking closely, most of these people weren’t even over 20, considering they’re mostly in the ranks of Root Saints.
While it can take hundreds of years for someone in a medium world to become a Root Saint, in an Immortal world, 20-year-olds can easily become even Core Formation cultivators.
So this shows just how weak and fragile these people were.
"Wonderful..." A smile appeared on the dark elf’s face.
"Lord Gelen, these are the batch our people managed to capture. There were some challenges on the way here, but we managed to sort it out."
"This means they are not going to be missed, right?" Gelen asked with a wicked grin.
"Even if they are going to be missed, none of those weak, spineless idiots would dare go against our Dark Elf race. They are too scared to make a move."
"That is good, then." Gelen turned to the chained slaves and grinned.
The terrified expressions on their faces said it all; they were scared senseless, and that was probably because of the rumors they had heard about the Dark King’s youngest son.
They all knew they were as good as dead because the moment they appeared before this bastard, there was no way out for them.
He is vile and extremely evil. People’s suffering is like candy to his ear. He cherishes their pain and enjoys their screams. So every last one of them knows there is no way out for them.
"Divide them into groups of ten each. The first hunt will take place tomorrow." His subordinates nodded and started separating the slaves into groups of ten.
What he meant by ’the hunt’ was that the ten in each group would be given a chance at freedom. They would be released to run into the forest, and he would hunt them down.
If they managed to escape, that would be their fortune. If they got caught by his arrows, then that was their bad luck. Regardless, nobody was ever able to escape from him.
After grouping them, they got 24 groups, showing they had captured 240 slaves this time around. They gave each group a number.
Within group 2, there is a loli who, despite the despair around her, seems okay with the situation she has found herself in.

There was no sorrow or pain in her eyes. If anything, she seems okay with death hanging over her head. Her fellow red foxes have their fluffy ears and tails twitching, but she seems content with her life.

This wasn’t because she had given up hope. To her, life is not worth living, for she has been on her own ever since she learned to walk. Life had already been cruel to her from the start, so she is fine with how she has turned out.
At least in two days’ time, her misery will end.
After dividing them, they kept each group in a separate cage and locked it with an enchanted lock. Tomorrow, the first batch of hunting will start.
Inside the harem tower, Lani had just finished taking her bath and was getting ready to head back to the legion tower when something vibrated inside her space ring.
Reaching inside, she pulled out a book with a black cover. Her expression darkened when the death note appeared in her hand for the first time since she received it.
Unlike some of her sisters, who received weapons after their true-name awakening, she received a kill book called Death Note.
Whenever a name appears in it, she is expected to kill.
It had been dormant for a while now. But today, it gave her a name.
Opening to the first page, she began reading the mission details.
[Mission Grade: Black]
[Target: Gelen Darkwood (True Immortal)]
[Location: Planet Offin - Dark Continent]
[Mission Details: Gelen Darkwood, the youngest heir of the Dark Elf race, had become a nuisance and a threat to the Red Fox and Storm Human races over the years.

His continuous killing of innocents had gone unnoticed for a long time simply because nobody had the spine to do what is right. However, that ends now when he points his arrows at a Heaven’s daughter.
Your mission is to kill him and rescue the unfortunate souls that he planned on killing next.]
[Duration: Two Days]
[Rewards:]
↠ Memory Key (Past Life)
↠ Black Stone
↠ First Volume of the Dark Records
[Note: You can take two aids with you. But the target must die by your weapon. Failure to kill him with your own hand will result in mission failure.]
Lani closed the book and stored it away. She then put on her clothes and left the harem tower to go see her big sister.
Since it had come to this, she knew letting her big sister know what had happened was the only way she could come up with a good plan.

She expected to receive a much smaller mission, one in which she would be tasked with killing a Life- or maybe even a Death-stage target. However, getting a True Immortal as her target is just too much of a danger.
But with Vexthra’s help, she knew it was possible to get this mission done in two days.

They are a race of red foxes, a rare breed of foxes, just like the sky foxes.
There is the Raden family, ruled by the Storm Immortal.
They are a race of Storm Humans, beings born with a natural affinity for water.
Their affinity allows them to manipulate water in various forms.
The last is the Adin family, ruled by the Dark King.
They are Dark Elves and the most vile race on that planet.
They are also the strongest, considering even the youngest heir is a True Immortal and the scum that had been plaguing the red foxes and Storm Humans for hundreds of years now.
"Young master, the fresh batch of slaves is in," a young dark elf spoke from behind a door.
Inside the room, a lean dark elf sat on the bed, three red foxes working on his little prince.
Hearing his subordinate’s words, a smile appeared on his face.
He pushed aside the three red foxes and put on his clothes, rushing out of the room with a beaming smile on his face.
"Take me to them."
He and his subordinate took to the sky and vanished from sight.
A few minutes later, they arrived in a small clearing where the rest of it was a vast forest.
Lined up and in chains were over 200 red foxes and Storm Humans.
Looking closely, most of these people weren’t even over 20, considering they’re mostly in the ranks of Root Saints.
While it can take hundreds of years for someone in a medium world to become a Root Saint, in an Immortal world, 20-year-olds can easily become even Core Formation cultivators.
So this shows just how weak and fragile these people were.
"Wonderful..." A smile appeared on the dark elf’s face.
"Lord Gelen, these are the batch our people managed to capture.
There were some challenges on the way here, but we managed to sort it out."
"This means they are not going to be missed, right?" Gelen asked with a wicked grin.
"Even if they are going to be missed, none of those weak, spineless idiots would dare go against our Dark Elf race.
They are too scared to make a move."
"That is good, then." Gelen turned to the chained slaves and grinned.
The terrified expressions on their faces said it all; they were scared senseless, and that was probably because of the rumors they had heard about the Dark King’s youngest son.
They all knew they were as good as dead because the moment they appeared before this bastard, there was no way out for them.
He is vile and extremely evil.
People’s suffering is like candy to his ear.
He cherishes their pain and enjoys their screams.
So every last one of them knows there is no way out for them.
"Divide them into groups of ten each.
The first hunt will take place tomorrow." His subordinates nodded and started separating the slaves into groups of ten.
What he meant by ’the hunt’ was that the ten in each group would be given a chance at freedom.
They would be released to run into the forest, and he would hunt them down.
If they managed to escape, that would be their fortune.
If they got caught by his arrows, then that was their bad luck.
Regardless, nobody was ever able to escape from him.
After grouping them, they got 24 groups, showing they had captured 240 slaves this time around.
They gave each group a number.
Within group 2, there is a loli who, despite the despair around her, seems okay with the situation she has found herself in.
There was no sorrow or pain in her eyes.
If anything, she seems okay with death hanging over her head.
Her fellow red foxes have their fluffy ears and tails twitching, but she seems content with her life.
This wasn’t because she had given up hope.
To her, life is not worth living, for she has been on her own ever since she learned to walk.
Life had already been cruel to her from the start, so she is fine with how she has turned out.
At least in two days’ time, her misery will end.
After dividing them, they kept each group in a separate cage and locked it with an enchanted lock.
Tomorrow, the first batch of hunting will start.
Inside the harem tower, Lani had just finished taking her bath and was getting ready to head back to the legion tower when something vibrated inside her space ring.
Reaching inside, she pulled out a book with a black cover.
Her expression darkened when the death note appeared in her hand for the first time since she received it.
Unlike some of her sisters, who received weapons after their true-name awakening, she received a kill book called Death Note.
Whenever a name appears in it, she is expected to kill.
It had been dormant for a while now.
But today, it gave her a name.
Opening to the first page, she began reading the mission details.
[Mission Grade: Black]
[Target: Gelen Darkwood (True Immortal)]
[Location: Planet Offin - Dark Continent]
[Mission Details: Gelen Darkwood, the youngest heir of the Dark Elf race, had become a nuisance and a threat to the Red Fox and Storm Human races over the years.
His continuous killing of innocents had gone unnoticed for a long time simply because nobody had the spine to do what is right.
However, that ends now when he points his arrows at a Heaven’s daughter.
Your mission is to kill him and rescue the unfortunate souls that he planned on killing next.]
[Duration: Two Days]
[Rewards:]
↠ Memory Key (Past Life)
↠ Black Stone
↠ First Volume of the Dark Records
[Note: You can take two aids with you.
But the target must die by your weapon.
Failure to kill him with your own hand will result in mission failure.]
Lani closed the book and stored it away.
She then put on her clothes and left the harem tower to go see her big sister.
Since it had come to this, she knew letting her big sister know what had happened was the only way she could come up with a good plan.
She expected to receive a much smaller mission, one in which she would be tasked with killing a Life- or maybe even a Death-stage target.
However, getting a True Immortal as her target is just too much of a danger.
But with Vexthra’s help, she knew it was possible to get this mission done in two days.

chapters.title: Chapter 1398: Mission Variables
paragraphs: "So you have finally received a Death Note mission."
Vexthra took the book from Lani and looked at the mission details. After reading it herself, she read it aloud to everyone, then turned back to Lani.
"Black mission from the get-go, huh?"
"I didn’t expect that, but I suppose that is what I have to deal with right now," Lani answered, not a bit scared.
She had been tasked by the Death Note to kill a True Immortal, while she herself is only a Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivator. That is seven realms above her
But despite the clear disadvantage she faced, she seemed okay and calm.
"Can you kill a True Immortal?" Vexthra asked, a bit amused, considering she herself had once fought a True Immortal when she was a mortal. However, her situation was a bit different.

She was a Death-stage warrior back then, so the gap between them was much lower than what Lani will be facing now. It is even a bit ridiculous to consider the idea of a Heavenly Ascension-stage mortal facing a True Immortal.
"If I can get within 10 meters of him, then he is as good as dead."

"Ten meters is a big ask. He is a True Immortal, so even if he is the weakest True Immortal in the Universe, there is just no way you can sneak up on him—not even within a 100-meter radius," Vexthra revealed, causing the ladies to sigh.
"I believe it is possible if all variables are put at the right places," Zaila said, making everyone turn to her. Seeing she had their attention, she smiled.

"Think about this. When it comes to True Immortals, like big sister said, they are sensitive. They are not easily deceived. So instead of using ways to sneak up on them, why not make it so he wouldn’t know he had been snuck up on?"
"What are you hinting at?" Elsa asked.

"Nothing too fancy. At first, I thought, why not allow Alina to create the greatest concealment formation for Lani to deploy when she is in position? To some extent, that can work, but it wouldn’t be enough.
The True Immortal would notice.
However, the mission only said she can take two aids; it said nothing about taking other weapons with her. This means Alina can create a powerful concealment formation for her.
Elsa can create a powerful soul attack, which we just have to transform into a talisman for her. And lastly, Princess Lovina can cook her most lethal poison for her weapon.
Then, in action, I can join her and use my mind attacks to disturb the bastard’s mind for a second. I believe that will give Lani all the time in the world to execute her move."
The ladies nodded in agreement with Zaila’s reasoning. With Alina’s brilliance, she can indeed work something out. As for Elsa, she has the strongest soul attacks since she is a soul cultivator.
Princess Lovina would finally get to reveal her hand and share the poisons she had been working on for the past couple of months with her sisters.
It is a good plan, but not perfect.
"There is one thing you are missing, ladies," Vexthra said, drawing everyone’s attention. "You are missing the part where the target is a True Immortal."
"While Zaila can indeed buy Lani a second to make her move, let’s consider things from a True Immortal’s perspective. If she were to be 0.0001 second late, her advantage would be taken from her.
But even if she manages to pull a fast one, let’s take a step back and consider a few details from the mission description.
First, it said the bastard is the youngest son of the Dark King. Obviously, such a person would have many people protecting him.
What if he were to have an Immortal King protecting him, or worse, multiple Immortal Kings?" The ladies’ expressions changed.

"That is not all. The mission ends in two days, so you have no time to scout and create a better plan. This means you are going in blind, and while that can be solved if I were to send Axiom or even a demigod with you, the mission again wants you to personally kill the bastard.

So you must consider the formations they would have in place and how to escape after the kill." Vexthra chuckled. "But here is where it gets dark. The mission wants you to kill the bastard, but it also requires you to save the Heavens Daughter."
"First of all, you don’t know what this person looks like. But even if you do, there is the situation where you must kill, rescue, and escape without triggering any alarm."
Lani turned pale, her previous confidence washed away, replaced by the sheer weight of the mission she had been given.
The odds, now that she had put some consideration into it, seemed rather staggering. She could tell the mission wouldn’t be easy at all.
"Why don’t we take a step back and analyse a few things?" Miryssa stepped in. "I believe if we know the variables, we can plan things well."
"What do you have in mind?" Vari asked, a bit sad that her disciple and sister had received such a hectic mission.

Lani had been with her for years, so she knew, to some extent, how she went about her activities and what her thought processes moved in times like this. So she knew she was feeling the weight of the mission right now.
"First, we know the target is a True Immortal and that he is the heir of the dark elf King. This means he lives in a palace mansion. Lani would have to break in, since it would be heavily guarded.
Once she does, she must locate the bastard and plan her next move. Personally, this mission can succeed if she finds him in a living room. That is where he would be vulnerable and less guarded.
Second, we know he is a Dark Elf, so we can already rule out the use of formations or concealments, since he would sense them a mile away.
Third, there is an issue with saving the Heavens Daughter after Lani has killed the True Immortal. She must know where the target is kept. But before that, she must know what the target looks like.
And when all these variables are met, there is the case of how sneakily one can sneak up on whoever might notice the anomaly when she kills the true immortal.
From my experience, there is always a way the fathers of such scums become aware whenever their bastard sons die.
Perhaps knowing the kind of life their kids live, they put measures in place to notify them whenever they are in danger. So there is that..."
The ladies looked at Miryssa with enlightened expressions after hearing how much variables Lani would have to overcome to kill the true Immortal.
Unity asked, "What do you know about Heaven’s Daughter? I believe the core of this mission revolves around her, so what can you tell us?"
"I have no idea, ladies," she answered.
She also turned to Vexthra, who frowned and shook her head. "I also don’t know."
Her answer caused her sisters to furrow their brows. "Don’t look at me, I don’t know everything."
"Well—"
"The Heaven’s Daughter is, as the name says, a daughter of the heavens..." Suddenly, Uncle Drew’s voice entered everyone’s ears, causing them to turn in his direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1399: Heaven’s Daughter
paragraphs: "Every Era, the heavens send their daughter to the land of mortals to experience what they never had the privilege to. They are basically born and left to fend for themselves.
During the Dark Era, the heavens’ daughter was someone who had never known peace, not even once. So when the dark creatures came, she fell.
However, her death was the signal that many had been waiting for. They always say that when the heavens’ daughter dies, the end of an era has come.

It wasn’t always the case, though. From what I have read, the heavens’ daughters are more than signals to announce the end of an era. They are fortunes left by the heavens to those who recognise their worth and take advantage of what they bring.

Basically, the heavens, in their bid to make sure every era ends in their favour, left their daughter with all kinds of good fortune that can only be used by those who know what they are looking for."
"So they are like wishing pods. You wish for something, and they give it to you," Camilla asked, but Uncle Drew shook his head.
"No. She is a good fortune, in the sense that if you have her around, good things will happen to you. They take all the bad and turn it into good for you."
The ladies nodded, finally getting something to work with.
They are now aware that the heavens’ daughters are always unfortunate souls. Beings who are probably tired of this life.
They may be the daughters of the heavens, but she lacked the fortune the heavens have. They were basically born to suffer. So there is a chance this one is the same, too.
That, in a way, would narrow things down a bit.
But yet still...
"The scope is too big. From what Uncle Drew said, the heavens’ daughter wouldn’t know her true identity, so it isn’t like Lani can ask her when she sees her.
We need something that can narrow the scope down to a more structured format. This way, we can easily create a good rescue plan," Vexthra said.
Her sisters nodded at her words. They were still nowhere near finding ways to locate the heavens’ daughter. If they knew what she looked like, perhaps that would narrow things down a bit.
"Uncle Drew, is there something else you can tell us that will help narrow this down for us?" Ingrid asked.
"Nothing much. But you must know that the heavens’ daughter didn’t die during the Divine Era. She grew and became a goddess. Later, she vanished and was never seen again."
"What was her name or title or divinity?"
"I believe she was called the Goddess of Love and Passion."

Vexthra’s eyes widened. Selene and a few of her sisters, who had learned about her life before she became the Goddess of Hatred and Resentment, also had surprised looks on their faces when they heard what Uncle Drew said.
They knew that before she became who she is now, she and her twin sister had plans to become the goddesses of love and passion. That was the divinity they planned on comprehending.

She would comprehend the Dao of Love, and her sister was to go for the Dao of Passion. Then, when the time came to attain divinity, they would merge their Daos and become the goddesses of love and passion.
But she died before that time could come.
So hearing that Heaven’s Daughter was once the Goddess of Love and Passion took her aback. It may be nothing, or it could be something.
First, she had a question.
"Can it be that Heaven’s Daughter reincarnates every Era?"
"I think so. From the forbidden records, it was recorded that the heavens created their daughter using everything they had, and so there is no reason for them to create a new one every era."
"If that is the case, then I think locating Heaven’s Daughter would be very simple," Vexthra said with a smile, causing her sisters to look at her wildly.
"How so?" Lilian asked.
"Very simple. We just have to send Unity with Lani. More accurately, we need to send the Goddess of Love version of her with Lani. I believe she will be able to resonate with the heavens’ daughter."
"Big sister, are you saying Heaven’s Daughter is the reincarnation of your twin sister?" Selene asked, her heartbeat rising.

"I am not one hundred percent sure, but based on what Uncle Drew said, there is a chance it would be her. I would have gone with you, but I have a feeling this Death Note mission will not take kindly to you having a god as your aid.

Who knows what kind of calamity mission it would spawn next time for you? So you will go with Unity. If she is indeed the reincarnation of my sister, there is a 100% chance she will resonate with her, and you can easily reach her."
"That will be great for sure," Miryssa stepped in again. "However, how are we going to handle the elephant in the room—you know, the killing of the True Immortal part?"

Uncle Drew grinned from the side and said, "From where I stand, you need only two people to handle the killing part. Since Lady Lani is the one to do the killing, then how about we create the perfect condition for her?"𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
He turned toward Adina. "You are a succubus, right?"
She nodded.

"I am not a seer, but I can see that bastard falling head over heels when he senses extreme Yin Essence. Since the mission is to be carried out in a room, you two just have to sneak in and let Lady Adina charm him.
I am sure he would fall for it, and well, the rest will depend on how you want to kill him."
Uncle Drew is just like Kent. He has a plan for almost anything. Just now, he came up with three plans that could help Lani complete her mission.
The plan he had just said has the highest success rate.
"Uncle Drew is right, though. I can charm that bastard even if he is an Immortal Lord. But I need access to the room for ten seconds."
"That can be arranged," Lani smiled, forming a hand seal. A few seconds later, a couple of runic texts started appearing in the air. Within a minute, the air was filled with thousands of runic texts.
"One of my many abilities is converting tangible things to shadows. I will be entering the mansion as a shadow, so you two would just have to hide in my shadow.
The rest will depend on how fast and silently I move."
"Then it is settled. Lani will be taking Unity and Adina on this mission. Unity will be in charge of saving Heaven’s Daughter while you two work together to kill the bastard."
"But there is the case where his death would trigger a war between the Dark Elves and the two other races," Uncle Drew said, already thinking beyond the mission.
Since the Dark Elves are predators of the Storm Humans and Red Foxes, there is a chance that if the youngest Dark heir dies, they would turn their weapons on them.
"That is simple. We just have to blame the kill on someone," Vexthra said with a small grin.
"Big sister, who are we going to blame for the kill?"
"Who else..."
The ladies, including the legion, widened their eyes and started laughing.
Inside the Alchemy Tower, Kent sneezed a few times and said... "Somebody is plotting evil against me..."

"You are a succubus, right?"
She nodded.
"I am not a seer, but I can see that bastard falling head over heels when he senses extreme Yin Essence.
Since the mission is to be carried out in a room, you two just have to sneak in and let Lady Adina charm him.
I am sure he would fall for it, and well, the rest will depend on how you want to kill him."
Uncle Drew is just like Kent.
He has a plan for almost anything.
Just now, he came up with three plans that could help Lani complete her mission.
The plan he had just said has the highest success rate.
"Uncle Drew is right, though.
I can charm that bastard even if he is an Immortal Lord.
But I need access to the room for ten seconds."
"That can be arranged," Lani smiled, forming a hand seal.
A few seconds later, a couple of runic texts started appearing in the air.
Within a minute, the air was filled with thousands of runic texts.
"One of my many abilities is converting tangible things to shadows.
I will be entering the mansion as a shadow, so you two would just have to hide in my shadow.
The rest will depend on how fast and silently I move."
"Then it is settled.
Lani will be taking Unity and Adina on this mission.
Unity will be in charge of saving Heaven’s Daughter while you two work together to kill the bastard."
"But there is the case where his death would trigger a war between the Dark Elves and the two other races," Uncle Drew said, already thinking beyond the mission.
Since the Dark Elves are predators of the Storm Humans and Red Foxes, there is a chance that if the youngest Dark heir dies, they would turn their weapons on them.
"That is simple.
We just have to blame the kill on someone," Vexthra said with a small grin.
"Big sister, who are we going to blame for the kill?"
"Who else..."
The ladies, including the legion, widened their eyes and started laughing.
Inside the Alchemy Tower, Kent sneezed a few times and said...
"Somebody is plotting evil against me..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1400: Black Mission (1)
paragraphs: Lani, Unity, and Adina quickly prepared and soon were ready to head to Planet Offin.

"Remember, the moment you manage to locate the place the Heaven’s Daughter is being kept, Unity must handle the rescue. That is the most critical mission here," Vexthra said, and Alina stepped forward and handed a talisman to Unity.
"This is a time array. It will slow down time for anyone other than you. The weaker they are, the more effect it will have on them." She gave her another Talisman after she received the first one.
"This one will leave a mark on anyone you want transported to the tower, even if there is danger around. Since the tower connection doesn’t work in times of danger, I have this secondary fix for it.
When activated, I will feel it and pull whoever is marked into the tower. All you have to do is have the person within your line of sight or sensing range."
She received the talisman and stored it away.
Alina smiled and moved to Lani and Adina and handed them the same talisman that would allow her to pull whoever she wanted into the tower.
"You three should be careful. This mission has so many unknown variables, so you must be on high alert." They nodded. After sharing hugs, Lani retrieved the Death Note and activated the portal.
"We will be right back."
With smiles on their faces, they walked into the portal and vanished from sight.
[Planet Offin - Dark Continent]
All three of them appeared in front of a small forest not too far from the capital city of the Dark Elves. The mission is the Dark Continent, so the portal took them there.

"Alright, get into my shadow," Lani said, activating her skill, which turned Adina and Unity into shadows. They merged with her shadow. After making sure they are alright, she also transformed into a shadow and started moving toward the East.

The Dark Continent is the largest continent on Planet Offin. It has the largest population, too, which in a way makes them even more dangerous, considering almost 95% of the dark elf race are warriors.
They are a warrior race, so they mostly work toward making sure every last one of them becomes a warrior who can fight in times of war.
However, because of their number and daily activities, Lani knew getting into the dark city wouldn’t be too hard. There will be people she can use to enter.
3o minutes later, she arrived on a large road leading to what she assumed to be the dark city.
Recognizing this is what she wanted, she started moving in the direction of where the tracks led the most.

It is logical to assume that where the tracks led the most is the direction of the city, since in most cases, people go to cities and stay a few days or weeks before leaving. This means there wouldn’t be more tracks leading away from the city.

Most of the tracks will be people coming into the city. And knowing the dark city is the largest and most heavily populated city on Planet Offin, Lani came to the conclusion that she is moving in the right direction.
2 hours later, a carriage caught up to her.
Using the speed they were moving at to her advantage, she jumped into the shadow of the carriage and slowly climbed into the carriage, sneaking into the shadow of a True Immortal.
Inside the carriage was an Immortal King, one of the Dark Captains.
He serves directly under the Eastern Dark General, one of the five Generals of the Dark Elf race. He went on an errand for the Dark General and was rushing back to the city to report.
Inside the carriage with him were two True Immortal Dark Elves, one male and the other female.
"Captain, do you think the General would accept the proposal the Northern General has for him?" the female dark elf asked.
"I honestly don’t know. The Northern General had always been jealous of the Eastern General. Not that I blame him. Being a personal guard of Lord Gelen is an honour everyone would cherish.

Lord Gelen has been generous over the years, allowing the General to reach the Immortal Emperor stage and even form six immortal rings. So he is just jealous and hurt... that was why he made such ridiculous demands."
"It is indeed a bit hurtful. I even heard Lord Gelen would start his hunt after tomorrow. If he succeeds in having fun, there is a chance he would allow the General to have some days off.
If I were the Northern General, I would be jealous too," the male Dark Elf added, causing the Dark Captain to smile.
"Well, it is above our pay grade to think about something this important. We just have to report what we have been sent on. The rest will take care of itself."
Lani remained quiet and hidden in the shadows, but she and the two ladies were hearing everything the three dark elves said.

From just the small things they heard, it became clear to them that there is an Immortal Emperor in the picture, and judging by how they spoke highly of him and the target she would have to kill, it was clear the bastard is heavily protected.

’This changes nothing. We now have a way into the palace, so we follow the same plan,’ Lani’s voice entered Unity and Adina’s heads. ’Unity will handle the rescue, while Adina and I will go in for the kill.’
’If things turn upside down, you two should leave. I still have something up my sleeve to get the job done.’
’Rest assured, Lani. The moment I locate the Heavens Daughter, I will take her away before anything happens. And well, I also have a trump card up my sleeve, so don’t worry about me.’
30 minutes later, they arrived before a large city gate, which opened for them to enter the city. It was only normal for them to enter without inspection.
Of course, even if they were to do so, unless they knew what they were looking for, they wouldn’t find Lani hidden in the shadow of one of the True Immortals.
It took them another 20 minutes to move through the streets of the city before arriving in front of another gate. Just like with the main gate, they were allowed entry.
They moved for a couple of minutes before they arrived in front of a mansion. At the gate, four True Immortals stood at attention the moment they saw the carriage pull up.

Inside the carriage, the Immortal King turned to his two subordinates. "Head toward the training ground. Since Lord Gelen will be hunting in a few days, you will have some free time to yourselves. Use it well, because after the hunt, we will be heading to the border."
"Okay, Captain."
They got down from the carriage, and they went their separate ways. The two True Immortals headed west, where the training grounds were, while the Dark Captain headed into the mansion.
Lani, of course, was hidden inside the shadow of the female True Immortal.
Along the way, they passed by many mansions. Lani kept her senses spread wide, making sure every last hint of a clue was captured.
After a few minutes, a new mansion came into sight. This time, Lani sensed how the two True Immortals slowed down.
’Gotcha.’
’Same here. I know where Heaven’s Daughter is being kept,’ Unity also spoke.
’Where?’ Adina asked.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝕨𝕖𝗯𝚗𝚘𝕧𝕖𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝕞
’She is at the training ground.’
